data.objectivesText: Raise the standard of Ironforge, call out the trogg Headsplitter and kill it, then report to Captain Rugelfuss.
description: The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.
The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
data.partialDialogue: That banner looks like it's been in a war!
data.turnInDialogue: You found Ylva's body? Ah, the poor woman. She said she was going to show the troggs that Ironforge would never fall to their kind. She went looking for a few mountaineers who never returned from a patrol through trogg country. She was always too independent-minded to be cautious. Now we know what happened.I'll take the banner back and make sure it's cleaned up and displayed. You should take her weapon. May it serve you well against the troggs.

data.objectivesText: Deliver a Jar of Snow to Norric Lochthane.
description: My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy settling in and learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Could you do this for me? Head over to South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts.
data.partialDialogue: Eh? What do you want?
data.turnInDialogue: This jar is for me?Snow! Grenhild did it! She sent the snow that I asked for!A pity, though, I was hoping she would come and visit herself.Uh, anyway, you probably deserve a little something for your effort. Here you go.

data.objectivesText: Find and defeat the crocolisk Daggerfang and bring back Marek's knife.
description: Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.
Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.
I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
data.partialDialogue: How goes the huntin'?
data.turnInDialogue: Hah! You did it! I never thought that ol' croc would get its comeuppance, but that does the trick!Oh ah... y'know, I had to get me another knife, but maybe that one will bring you some good luck. Why don't you hang onto it?

data.objectivesText: Collect 6 Dry Branches and bring them to Eleanor Shackleton.
description: My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."
If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.
data.partialDialogue: Welcome to my fire, traveler.
data.turnInDialogue: Extra firewood? That is always welcome. It will keep these old bones warm through the cold nights of the Glades.I have a sling for collecting wood myself, so you might as well hang onto that basket.

data.objectivesText: Bring 6 Soft Nightsaber Pelts to Aldria.
description: Hello, traveler! I hope you are enjoying your visit to our village. I like Dolanaar because it is small and rustic and everyone is friendly.

I'm a local trader, and I bring in all sorts of tools and trinkets that might be useful to you in your travels. Indeed, if you are interested in a trade, I find myself in need of some nightsaber pelts. While these majestic creatures are beautiful, the local ones are rather aggressive, so don't feel too bad about defending yourself.
data.partialDialogue: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?
data.turnInDialogue: Oh, these are wonderful. It is a shame to resort to violence with such majestic animals, but it is important to keep the roads safe, and these pelts will make beautiful blankets and shawls.Here, let me give you something to remember them. It is both soft and sturdy.

data.objectivesText: Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion.
description: I have received word back from Darnassus, ‹name›!

From the animal samples, we learned that the naga dominated these sea creatures to use as unwilling mounts and beasts of burden. The ones that were too obstinate, or too old or badly injured, they drove out for sport. Monstrous!
It is our sacred duty to put a stop to this!
The naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra, and they must be seizing threshers from off the shore. Find their beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her tools of domination!
data.partialDialogue: We will finally have resolution to this mystery, and the animals will have peace at last!
data.turnInDialogue: This has been a long journey, Orangequake, but it was worth it.At long last, you have wrested away the rod that the naga use to compel the sea creatures into their service. I will make sure it is destroyed, and the threshers and sea turtles can finally live in peace.Thank you again. Your persistence has finally been rewarded, and I, personally, am grateful to you.

data.objectivesText: Heal 5 Injured Deathguard with your Holy Light ability.
description: I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others.

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
data.partialDialogue: Mastery of the light will return, in time.
data.turnInDialogue: Pain is nothing new to those who have endured death, and as such the Forsaken are particularly hardy to it. Pain has a purifying property as well that you should embrace as a badge of honor and evidence that you are, in fact, still a servant of the light despite your new circumstances.Be well and walk in the light once more, ‹class›.

data.objectivesText: Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.
description: Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.
data.turnInDialogue: Tragically, more than a few of our brothers and sisters succumb to a similar madness after being risen. As precious as every Forsaken soul is, sometimes the best we can do is grant those that cannot acclimate a clean end.I will say a prayer to the light for her. data.objectivesText: Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of Brill. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.
description: Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training.
One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.
data.turnInDialogue: Welcome aboard, ‹class›. It's always encouraging to see more of our number roaming these lands. There are many here in Brill in need of assistance from adventurers such as yourself. Seek employment and grow stronger in the light. Return to me whenever you need training.When you've proven yourself to myself and the people of Brill, I will provide guidance for the next leg of your journey.Go with the light, ‹class›.

data.objectivesText: Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.
description: It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal.
If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery at Northface Rock. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.
data.turnInDialogue: Another fresh recruit? Welcome to Tyr's Watch, brother.

data.objectivesText: Slay 8 Vile Fin Attackers and 8 Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.
description: Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.
data.turnInDialogue: We appreciate the assistance. I'm sure this won't stop the attacks entirely, but it'll hopefully slow them down a bit. It's hard enough rebuilding this place without a murloc trying to stab you in the back with a spear.

description: Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.
When you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.
I'm very glad to have met you, ‹name›. May the light be your guide.
data.partialDialogue: Welcome to Bandarion Keep, ‹class›. It's always good to see a new face.

data.objectivesText: Collect 12 pieces of Sturdy Lumber from Shadowvale in Tirisfal Glades.
description: This far from the Undercity, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.

The ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.
data.partialDialogue: They say location is everything. While this fortress may look imposing perched upon these bluffs, its turning out to be quite the challenge to stay supplied this far from proper civilization. An unfortunate oversight on our part.
data.turnInDialogue: I'm glad to see that your trip to Shadowvale bore fruit. I'll send Breton and a few of the other new recruits over later to clear the rest of the cellar out and retrieve anything left down in the dark.

data.objectivesText: Slay 8 Tarnished Drudges, 6 Tarnished Zealots, and collect the head of Commander Rudolph Gelhardt in Tirisfal Glades.
description: Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.

As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.
data.partialDialogue: The Tarnished threaten what little goodwill we have with the other Forsaken. As much as it pains me to cross blades with our former brothers and sisters, they must be stopped if our fledgling order is to survive.
data.turnInDialogue: Excellent work, Cola. Every time one of these Tarnished strike out and kill one of the Forsaken, it becomes that much easier for our detractors to stoke mistrust towards us paladins. Eliminating them will help further our cause and solidify our place here in Tirisfal.I suspect it may take a long time for us to be fully embraced by the Forsaken and the horde. It could take years... or maybe even decades, but the best we can do is keep trying to prove ourselves.

The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?

description: A most unfortunate turn of events in Silverpine has presented a unique opportunity for us to prove our worth in the eyes of the horde.

A pair of dignitaries from the Earthen Ring went missing in Silverpine Forest en route to Tarren Mill. We don't know much else but rumors say that this is becoming quite the diplomatic incident. If we can recover these missing persons, it could help gain us the legitimacy we so dearly need.
We have a man at The Sepulcher, Trevan Rol. Travel there and speak with him.

data.objectivesText: Speak with Deathguard Baldren about the mysterious Earthen Ring travelers who recently passed through The Sepulcher.
description: Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.
Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
data.turnInDialogue: I might not care for you paladins, but I will say that your timing is impeccable. It's better to be lucky than good, I suppose?

data.objectivesText: Investigate Fenris Isle to the east and learn the fate of the Earthen Ring traveling party.
description: Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.
If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, its a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.
I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.

data.objectivesText: Retrieve the Fenris Isle Key from the Rot Hide Gnolls and use it to free Lumina Windsinger.
description: Quel'dorei? No, I am no "quel'dorei". I am Lumina Windsinger and I am shen'dorei. One of the Windshaper Skyborne.

I came to these lands as a guest of the Earthen Ring. My companion Banon and I were passing through Silverpine to reach the Arathi Highlands so that we could study the elemental convergences there. Clearly, we didn't make it.
We have no time for this now though. Kill the gnolls nearby. Retrieve the key to this cage and free me. I will tell you the rest once we are safely away.
data.partialDialogue: Gnolls are the second worst creatures I've encountered yet on Azeroth.
data.turnInDialogue: Thank you, ‹class›. Unfortunately we aren't out of danger yet.

data.objectivesText: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
description: I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.
If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.
data.partialDialogue: Oh. You're back?
data.turnInDialogue: The potion didn't work? Of course it didn't work. You brought me insufficient hearts. The recipe clearly calls for six. You brought three.However, I confess I hadn't considered applications for murloc parts until now...<Renferrel takes the eyes.>I can afford to sacrifice a few of my own hearts to get your Deathstalker's strength back.

When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.
Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?

description: Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?
That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.
I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.
data.partialDialogue: Don't worry about me, I'm a big girl. I can take care of myself. Just don't tell anyone I am hiding here, it's our little secret.
data.turnInDialogue: You brought me murloc eyes! I am so excited for my first REAL potion I can't breathe!I snuck out and grabbed a few more herbs while you were away and found some empty vials downstairs. Um... you can do the mixing this time.<The child watches enthusiastically you mix the ingredients, but her nose crumples as you add the eyes. The concoction takes on a sickly orange in mere seconds.>Wow! See, I was right. I wouldn't drink that, but here's my recipe if you wanted to make more. Come back sometime!

data.objectivesText: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
description: It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not worry, but it's been days.
There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
data.turnInDialogue: What I asked of you was not fair, nor would it have been unjust for you to simply walk away. Thank you stranger. I am unable to repay you in kind but I hope one of these is acceptable.I hope our paths cross again without such sorrow.

data.objectivesText: Kill Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron for Deathguard Kristof in Brill.
description: Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth.
Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, ‹name›.
If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.
data.turnInDialogue: While I have no doubt something of his kind will be replaced, we can only hope their ranks thin in the meantime.Thank you Dead.

data.objectivesText: Speak with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
description: Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We've been awaiting your arrival and anticipating your much needed help here in Thendal Village. I imagine you are brimming with both nerves and excitement for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.
<Ailee smiles kindly.>
Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
data.turnInDialogue: Gale's greetings, Unwanted. I am honored to bestow your coming of age relic today as you are recognized for the potential you bring to the shen'dorei. Our people have faced great hardship and persecution in our complex history.Today you are given this relic which is one of many held by those before you. Someday when your ashes are scattered to the winds it will pass to another to continue our tradition.As you take this relic with you know that the winds of home will be with you wherever you travel.

data.objectivesText: Slay 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove.
description: We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.
The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.
Head east and cull some of the vuldren there.
data.turnInDialogue: Thank you for your service to Zephras, young ‹class›.The vuldren are typically quite docile, but the animals that call Zephras home can sense when the magic on the winds is out of balance, which can lead to dangerous and unpredictable behavior if left unchecked.

description: One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove.
Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
data.partialDialogue: Such pests cannot be allowed to find root in our peaceful grove. An infestation can quickly grow dangerous if left unchecked.
data.turnInDialogue: Judging by the amount of bug entrails covering you, this must be quite the infestation.

data.objectivesText: Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.
description: If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.
Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.
Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.
data.partialDialogue: Cirrusflies aren't to be underestimated. They might not seem dangerous, but you have to watch out for the bigger ones. The bigger they are, the meaner!
data.turnInDialogue: Excellent work, Dogwalker. You'd make a fine ranger if this whole "adventurer" thing doesn't work out for you.

data.objectivesText: Speak to the Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove.
description: Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.
Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them.
My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.
data.turnInDialogue: Rorian sent you? Good. I could use your aid.

data.objectivesText: Slay 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.
description: The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.
Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.
Will you lend me your aid, ‹class›?
data.turnInDialogue: It pains me to shed shen'dorei blood here in the grove, but we do what we must.

data.objectivesText: Bring a Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro.
description: While we owe much of our prosperity to the elements of wind, the path we walk requires that we obey the call of all four of the primary elements and undertake a trial for each. Before you begin your first trial in earnest however, you must prove the strength of your resolve.

Travel to the standing stones to the east. A force of Al'Aketh converts has been spotted there and they must be driven off. Confront the cultists there and bring me one of their signets as proof of your deeds.
data.partialDialogue: The Al'Aketh cult represents the most direct and urgent danger to our homeland. Their increasingly extremist actions have destabilized our society and damaged our already-weakened connection to the spirits of the four winds. The elements demand action to prove our resilience and resolve, which are traits that are endemic to the domain of the element of earth.
data.turnInDialogue: You have returned and brought what I have requested and thus your grit and determination are unquestionable. You are ready for the next step, Harten.

data.objectivesText: Find the Rise of Spirits and drink the Earth Sapta.
description: A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few shaman know the recipe.
The sapta is always drunk in a sacred place, and never anywhere else--remember that.
Seek out the Rise of Spirits up the pass northeast of here. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you will see what you need see.
data.turnInDialogue: Ah... Frooterz... child of the four winds... You seek understanding. You seek answers. Why have the winds left you? How may you get them back? These are answers I cannot provide, for I do not know the motives or movements of the winds.I can, however, teach you much of the earth. Its strength, its resolve. Even here, high in this endless sea of clouds, you are still a creature of the earth. If you hope to find the strength to speak to the spirits of the four winds once more, this is the path you must walk.

data.objectivesText: Bring the Rough Quartz to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove.
description: Take this Rough Quartz from me and bring it to the one you call Windshaper Boro as proof of our meeting. He will craft a totem for you, and this shard will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others.
Be patient, ‹name›. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what the elements ask of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.
data.partialDialogue: As you will come to learn, the path we walk is not as simple as it may seem. While we seek to find the voice needed to speak with the spirits of the winds, the winds are but one of the elemental forces of this world. Only through understanding, and--we hope--mastery of all four elements will we regain our voice to again sing the songs of the wind.
data.turnInDialogue: Good!The totem I will craft for you is more than a symbol of your status among ‹class›--it has abilities beyond that. One use of the totem is as a focus for spells. Those spells are tied to the earth, and as you earn greater and greater wisdom, more of the earth's abilities will be made accessible to you.The trainers will know when you are ready for greater knowledge.But for now, take this earth totem...

data.turnInDialogue: This is most troubling, but unfortunately unsurprising. We've been aware of the cult's movements for some time, but we've been content to watch from afar. Their agitation of the wind spirits near the standing stones is a clear escalation on their part.You've performed a difficult but necessary service for Thendal Grove, Ranir. Thank you.

description: Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the south. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
data.partialDialogue: What I ask of you is not easy, but you must be prepared for much greater challenges if you are to survive long enough to be of service to Zephras Isle.
data.turnInDialogue: Very well done. You've felled beasts and laid low cultist interlopers. You have shown great promise but your path must soon take you beyond the relative safety of Thendal Village.

data.objectivesText: Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.
description: You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.
The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.
data.turnInDialogue: Rorian has told me much of you. I am likely unknown to you, but I am a member of the Council of Elders here on Zephras Isle. I've come to read the flow of the winds here in Thendal Grove. I'm also here to assess young shen'dorei such as yourself that are coming of age.So tell me, are you ready to take your next step? Are you ready to serve Zephras Isle?

data.objectivesText: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
description: One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
data.turnInDialogue: Aetheen sent you, then? I'll confess, you don't look like much to me, but Shen'dar Village won't turn down willing aid, much less aid sent from Elder Aetheen herself.

description: The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
data.partialDialogue: The ursera have grown far more aggressive of late. I wonder what has changed to cause this shift in behavior?
data.turnInDialogue: Well done, ‹class›. The Rangers of the Grove are in your debt.

data.objectivesText: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.
description: Well hello there, ‹name›! Want to play a game?
All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.

The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!
data.partialDialogue: Using your ability to walk on air can get you out of--and, well... into--all kinds of trouble!
data.turnInDialogue: How many times do I need to tell Myriaal not to encourage others to make reckless usage of our skyborne gifts!That being said, I suppose that a little bit of practice in the relative safety of the village is... acceptable.In the future I'd simply suggest you to use your ability judiciously. You do not want to exhaust your magic thoughtlessly and then not be able to use it when you truly need it.

data.objectivesText: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.
description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, ‹name›. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local hunter trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
data.partialDialogue: Ah, ye got me letter, Busch... good.Time was when ye'd not catch a ‹race› dead wit' a bow in their hand--no more, I guess. It's good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and man eatin' beasts in the area.
data.turnInDialogue: Get yerself squared away, learn the lay o' the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.This land is grown' more dangerous, and as ye meet other folk, I think ye'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a skilled ‹class› can give 'em. Good luck.

data.objectivesText: Examine the Glowing Recall Crystal, then speak with Dorii Brightwhisper in Thendal Grove.
description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident mage trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.
data.partialDialogue: Greetings, Derek. I'm pleased to have the privilege of furthering your magical studies.
data.turnInDialogue: Let me have a look at you. Yes, I believe you will make a fine young ‹class›. The power of the arcane has waned amongst our people, but there are those who would seek to rediscover much of what we've lost in the millennia we've spent here amongst the clouds. I am sure that you will lead the charge in this never ending search for arcane knowledge, and ultimately make us proud.Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.

data.turnInDialogue: The way of the ‹class› is fraught with danger, and only those with the keenest senses and quickest reflexes can thrive in the wilds. I look at you and I am reminded of myself when I stood before my mentor, so many years ago. I believe that you have what it takes, but in the end that is up to you alone.Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.

description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident rogue trainer--Akeri Duskblade--has requested to speak with you. He left this note, so read that first, then seek him out inside the watchtower, here in the village.
He's a shady fellow, but then again, so are you. I think you'll get along well.
data.partialDialogue: <Akeri eyes you suspiciously.>
data.turnInDialogue: I almost did not hear you approach me, young ‹class›.Almost.Almost won't be good enough when you leave Thendal Grove. You must be a slender blade, silent and steady. Ever vigilant and ever mindful of your surroundings. You might have what it takes to survive the dangers of Zephras. You also might end up with your throat slit in a ditch. Ultimately that's entirely up to you.Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.

description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident Shaman trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.
data.partialDialogue: Winds guide you, Falar.
data.turnInDialogue: Can you hear it? The whispers of the winds? Doubtful, considering that the spirits stopped speaking with us when they left us those years ago.Those among us who would seek audience with the spirits of the four winds once more hone our understanding of the elements and the natural world, dearly hoping to reestablish the dialogue that was so abruptly ended.Would you walk this path and master the elements?Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps and I will train you.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
data.partialDialogue: Greetings, I am Xyton Silverwind, keeper of druidic lore.
data.turnInDialogue: The flora and fauna of Zephras Isle represent a rich tapestry of vibrant life. The ecosystem requires constant balance to maintain the harmony of nature, and we druids are the keepers of that balance. I see much potential in you, but this path is not an easy one, and you will need guidance as you grow in strength as a student of the fang, the claw, the feather, and the branch.Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.

data.objectivesText: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
description: You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.
Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
data.turnInDialogue: Checked in with Illaya then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Everyone here is well aware that we've got bigger problems than their quibbles.Now that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands and I've got a bandit problem that I was hoping you could help me with.

data.objectivesText: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.
description: As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.
Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.
data.partialDialogue: If you ask me, I think Prideclaws are actually kind of cute. From a safe distance... and while standing behind someone holding a sword, of course.
data.turnInDialogue: I didn't say it wouldn't be a dirty job, did I?

data.turnInDialogue: Well done, and quickly too. Not too bad at all.

data.objectivesText: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.
description: There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.
I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.
data.turnInDialogue: With the bandits dispersed, that is one less problem for us to deal with. Though I confess that now I worry that any bandits who survived may turn next to the cult for protection, further bolstering their increasingly alarming numbers.Still though, we'll take the victories where we can get them.

data.objectivesText: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.
description: The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.
For now, just don't get in anyone's way.
data.partialDialogue: What did you learn?
data.turnInDialogue: Lorthuna herself was there? She's the leader of the whole damned cult!If they are making a move on Shen'dar Village and the western watchtower, we've got to be ready. What is strange is... why the watchtower?The Village I can understand, but the tower? It doesn't have much strategic significance, other than as a minor lookout post.Regardless, we will be prepared for them. They'll find that highlanders aren't as easy to catch flat footed as they might think.

data.objectivesText: Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.
description: It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.

Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.
data.turnInDialogue: What is this? A new acolyte seeking to serve the windlord sent by sister Sania? Truly we are blessed by the touch of the four winds this day!We welcome all who seek to bask in the blessings of Al'Akir.

Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.
data.partialDialogue: So you've come for training, then?
data.turnInDialogue: You are about to embark upon a dangerous journey. Our world is changing and it will need those who have the will to lead and protect others if our people hope to survive. As you grow in power you will need guidance. Come to me--I will do what I can to train you as you progress.Good luck, Zaelriel, may the winds guide you.

description: A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.
I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.
data.turnInDialogue: It was all I could do to stop myself from going over and joining you from my position here. I can only hope that these louts got the message and clear out of here soon.Thank you, ‹class›. You have the gratitude of the Rangers of Thendal Grove.

data.objectivesText: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.
description: Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.
data.partialDialogue: It feels good to turn the tables on these zealots.
data.turnInDialogue: Thank the winds you've returned!Sania Silverstream snuck out of town just before you returned, no doubt fleeing at the sight of our people arming themselves.You've done an incredible thing for the people of Shen'dar Village and we owe you a debt of gratitude. If the cult returns to the highlands, they will find that Shen'dar is not such an easy target.Winds guide you, Zaelriel.

data.objectivesText: Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.
description: I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.
data.partialDialogue: There's a lot of hungry and desperate skyborne here who need these supplies.
data.turnInDialogue: This is great! We've been barely squeaking by without our regular supply deliveries. I'll work with the constable to ensure that these supplies get redistributed to the townsfolk who are in most dire need.

data.objectivesText: Collect 3 Small Eggs and 8 Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.
description: Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.
I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?
data.partialDialogue: No matter how much things change here on Zephras and how uncertain things get, I always say that a pipe full of dried peacebloom and nice full belly is a comfort that can't be beat!
data.turnInDialogue: These eggs aren't easy to get but wind save me, they are DELICIOUS fried up in a bit of ursera tallow.If you've got a bit of time to spare and you enjoy cooking, I can teach you a few tips and tricks I've picked up. Say the word and I'd be happy to train you.

data.objectivesText: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
description: For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to the Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.
The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.
At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, ‹name›.
data.partialDialogue: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
data.turnInDialogue: <Valennia's expression darkens as she reads the letter.>Aonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers we have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.If you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.

data.objectivesText: Listen to what Illaya Amberwind has to say.
description: <Illaya smiles warmly at you.>

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift.
Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
data.partialDialogue: The world is changing and the path forward will be difficult. We have but one chance to save ourselves.
data.turnInDialogue: I think you now understand how important the mission of the Windshapers is. Every soul who commands the skysight is of vital importance if we hope to establish dialogue with the spirits of the winds once again.Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and the uncertainty of our safety here in Skywall, it is our responsibility as Windshapers to use our gifts to save our home and ensure that the Shen'dorei can survive these trying times.

data.objectivesText: Have a seat and speak with Rathiril Sunlance.
description: The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.
Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
data.partialDialogue: Our land is going through changes, but there may yet be some good to come of this.
data.turnInDialogue: The High Order's mission is vital to the survival of our people. We hold our elemental benefactors in the utmost regard, but we must face reality; they are gone now, and we are on our own.Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and uncertainties of our security on this plane, it is our destiny as Highborne descendants of our ancestral home of Eldre'Thalas to use our gifts to ensure that the shen'dorei can stand on our own once again.

data.name: Reading the Ley Lines
data.lede: A level 4 quest for the Alliance, from level 2.

knownStatus.raw: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
knownStatus.changeNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

data.objectivesText: Use your Read Ley Line racial ability at the ley line in Thendal Grove.
description: Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from ley lines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these ley lines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies.
Go to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a ley line there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.
data.turnInDialogue: Do you feel it? Yes? Good! You have taken your first steps. You'll find that with your abilities, you will be able to tap into latent magical energy in many locations. Doing so will provide a myriad of benefits, some profound, others more subtle. You won't know until you tap into them, But that's the best part of the gift... making the unknown known.If we are to survive these dire times, we must be unwavering in our search for knowledge... and power.

data.objectivesText: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.
description: As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the elemental spirits. Travel to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.

You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.
data.turnInDialogue: Like a muscle, your skysight must be exercised if you hope to grow stronger in the gift. Leveraging your skysight to bridge the distance between the mortal and the spiritual may prove invaluable to you in your adventures.You'd do well to remember what you've learned here today. Our ability to use our gifts to hear what the elements tell us could be the key to our survival.

It so happens that Valennia has been preparing a strategy for a potential assault on the Shrine for some time now. The only problem is, we will need help.
Speak with Valennia for the details.
data.turnInDialogue: Tensions between the Windshapers and High Order are high right now, but we couldn't hope to carry out this plan without both groups on board.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.

description: This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.
I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, ‹class›.
data.turnInDialogue: Belguilos is dead? Four winds bless you, ‹class›.We might just make it out of this alive after all.

data.objectivesText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.
description: Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.
I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Ayessa and help them stop Lorthuna.
Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, ‹class›.
data.turnInDialogue: I sent a few of our healers to ensure that Valennia and her remaining forces made it back in one piece. She should be resting in the High Elder's residence now.Muln has already departed back to Azeroth, but he and I spoke of what is next for the Windshapers and our mission to Azeroth. Unfortunately, the island is more vulnerable than ever now and we need a plan to protect Zephras from what is to come.

data.objectivesText: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.
description: H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...
<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
data.partialDialogue: What? Alvarion is alive?
data.turnInDialogue: <Aamelia listens while you explain what became of Alvarion.>At least I know he's going to be safe in Valanaar.Stranger, I hate to tell you this but I think my idiot husband likely just sent you here to die for nothing. If you have any sense at all, you should leave now. This isn't your fight.

description: Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.
Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.
Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me.
Let's see what you've got in a fight.
data.partialDialogue: These bandits are more likely to double cross and steal from each other than they are to steal from normal folks. I bet if Ferauu knew some of his people went rogue and came here early to tamper with the harvest, he'd kill them himself.
data.turnInDialogue: I watched you take down those bandits from the window. Not bad.

data.objectivesText: Gather 5 Flutterfly Dust from the Flutterflies around the Gustberry Lowlands.
description: I'm sure you've noticed the giant flutterflies out in the outer fields near the orchard? They are pleasant to look at, but they also have other benefits; namely their wing dust. It can be a mess, but if you can gather it up in large amounts, it has useful household applications.

Take this Flutterfly Swatter and give the big bugs a good swat for me. They'll usually just get scared and flee, but sometimes they'll take some offense. Either way, they'll give their rumps a shake and drop a pile of dust.
data.partialDialogue: Flutterflies are normally docile and calm, but rub them the wrong way and sometimes they'll surprise you.
data.turnInDialogue: This stuff can be a bit messy and it tends to get everywhere. You'll probably be shaking this out of your trousers for weeks, unfortunately. I do appreciate it, though. I've had this on my to-do list for weeks, but getting too far from the house when it's just me on my own with bandits lurking everywhere is a big risk.Don't bother asking me what I use this stuff for. Things. Stuff and things. Don't worry about it.

description: As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.
Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.
data.partialDialogue: I don't think I've had real meat for dinner in... well, too long.
data.turnInDialogue: These are big tenderloins! You must have taken down some real monsters out there.

data.objectivesText: Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.
description: The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.
Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.
data.partialDialogue: If you manage to bring me enough bandit masks, maybe I'll stitch a blanket out of them and give it to Ferauu.<Aamelia laughs loudly.>
data.turnInDialogue: When I said the bloodier the better, you really listened. Good. It lets me know you made it hurt.On a serious note, thank you for what you've done so far. I've been floating aimlessly around this farm for weeks as if I was just waiting for the end to come. I think I'm starting to have hope again.Ferauu and his thugs are due any time now. All that's left is to go out and face them. What do you say, will you see this through to the end with me?

data.objectivesText: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.
description: You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.
This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.
On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.
data.partialDialogue: There's not enough stormapples in skywall to repay you for this.
data.turnInDialogue: I... can't believe it's over. I need to stop and calm myself before my heart leaps right out of my chest.

description: <You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.>
...Function error...
...Question...
...What is....
...Function...
<These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?>
data.turnInDialogue: The construct? It's been wandering around the fields for decades. Since the wind elementals left us, I think. Alvarion suspected that it used to haul harvests to market, or maybe tend to livestock back before this was an orchard. That could have been a thousand years ago though.In the old days, the Windshapers used to maintain these constructs. We've talked about petitioning them to come and take a look at it, but it's never been a pressing concern to us. Mostly we just ignore it these days.

data.objectivesText: Find Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar.
description: Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the High Order here. The current Supreme Magister, Elaadrin Evengale and his people operate out of the lodge on the far southeastern part of Valanaar.

You should also take care, the High Order and Windshapers don't get along very well here. Be careful and give the Windshapers a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
data.turnInDialogue: Hello and welcome. Rathiril sent me a magical missive about you and he mentioned you had some promise.With you standing before me now, I can see why he suggested you seek me out. You have a vibrant arcane aura about you. Few enough of us anymore have the aptitude, let alone the will, to do what is needed to save our home. Do you have the boldness and strength needed to aid The High Order?I suppose we will see.

data.objectivesText: Find Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.
description: Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.

You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
data.turnInDialogue: Elder Amberwind sent me a message about you and your exploits in Shen'dar Village. You are most welcome here, friend.You have a strong aura, and you clearly have a resonance with the spirits. Fewer and fewer of us have the skysight of late, and Zephras needs those with the gift if we are to survive these trying times. I am glad you have found your way to me.I look forward to further making your acquaintance.

data.objectivesText: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
description: For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to the Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.
The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.
At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, ‹name›.
data.partialDialogue: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
data.turnInDialogue: <Valennia's expression darkens as she reads the letter.>Aonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers I have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.If you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.

data.objectivesText: Speak with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar.
description: I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, ‹name›.

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.
<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>
He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.
data.turnInDialogue: <Alvarion's eyes tear up as you finish retelling the story of what happened at the orchard.>I don't know how to thank you, friend. I came to Valanaar looking for hope. A vain hope, I was almost certain. But instead I found a hero. A real hero, like the stories from before we came to Skywall.I'll never forget what you did for us, Orsen. You'll always be welcome at the Windfield home.

description: Calling all anglers!

A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!
-- Gazlowe
data.partialDialogue: What can I do for ya, ‹race›?
data.turnInDialogue: Finally, somebody killed that thing! Do you know how hard it is to get a crew in the water when everyone in town's crying "Shark!"all the time?I might just put that monster's fin into a soup for dinner tonight, just to have the last laugh.

data.objectivesText: Listen to what Ayessa Dawnsinger has to say.
description: The Windshapers have been hard at work trying to respond to the current crisis on Zephras Isle. We have made several surprising discoveries in our search for the missing wind spirits, and we are developing a plan of action that could help us gain the means to save the island.
We'll need strong young adventurer's like yourself for this to work however. Please, if you have a moment, let us speak on this further.
data.turnInDialogue: So now you see? There is a world of knowledge and untapped potential outside of Skywall. This will never stop being our home, but I've come to believe that the path to our salvation lies below. We must travel to Azeroth and gain the power and means to save Zephras Isle. This is the way.Will you have the courage to join us when the time comes?

data.objectivesText: Listen to what Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar has to say.
description: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the sky above. You are one of us, and its youth like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... and beyond.
data.turnInDialogue: So do you now see? Rediscovering the ancient magic of our forebears is the key to unlocking the secrets of Zephras Isle and securing our future, but in order to save our home, we must rediscover what we've lost these past millennia.Azeroth is the key. The Kirin Tor will show us the way.While we make ready to leave, you should check in with the other members of the High Order here in Valanaar. Most of them have tasks that they could use help from one such as yourself to see completed.

data.objectivesText: Discover what became of Fillion Flamebreeze.
description: Seeking knowledge is the primary mandate of the High Order, but this work has never been more dangerous than it is now on Zephras.

One of our scholars--Fillion Flamebreeze--was en route to the Shen'dar Highlands to study the windborne magic that congregates in some areas there. Regrettably, he has not returned and we fear that something may have befallen him on the road.
If you can, please locate him for us. He was last seen on the road leading west from Valanaar towards Shen'dar Highlands.
data.turnInDialogue: <The satchel lying before you has a few specks of what appears to be dried blood on the flap. Studying the stain you also notice that the flap also has a name embroidered onto it. It reads "Fillion Flamebreeze".>

data.objectivesText: Travel to Shadowgale Forest and collect 8 Shriekling Talons for Iaadaria Bitterwind in Valanaar.
description: The Shadowgale Forest is incredibly dangerous and is usually off limits to normal adventurers. In recent months there's been an explosion in the shriekling population and they've started to expand their territory outside the woods, which is a potential problem. I have an interest in the alchemical properties of shriekling talons, so a much-needed culling also presents an opportunity for scholarly gain.
Travel to Shadowgale Forest and hunt the beasts. Bring me as many of their talons as you can.
data.partialDialogue: The High Order does not make it a habit to employ themselves as simple trappers and game wardens, but when performing a service such as this can lead to scholarly gain, we are happy to engage in acts of community service.
data.turnInDialogue: That is quite the haul of talons you've brought me. I cannot wait to dig into this!Thank you for your service to the High Order, ‹class›.

data.objectivesText: Alba Fairmoon wants you to collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills along the shoreline of Westfall.
description:
The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.
Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.
data.partialDialogue: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
data.turnInDialogue: I see... these gills appear to be healthy, for now. But we must not be complacent.

data.objectivesText: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.
description: When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.
A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment.
Its clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.
data.partialDialogue: The mark of a leader is the ability to admit when they were wrong. I don't agree with the Windshapers often, but they were right to dismiss the idea of trying to engage peacefully with the Al'Aketh. My attempt to take the high road cost a dear friend his life and is a mistake I will have to live with for the rest of my days.
data.turnInDialogue: The High Order prides ourselves in our pragmatism and logic, and logic dictates that the avoidance of conflict and loss of life is the most prudent option in most situations.<Elaadrin's eyes begin to glow and crackle with arcane energy.>...however, the cult mistook our prudence for weakness and they are not nearly ready to pay the cost of that error.

data.objectivesText: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it once there. Protect the Index from harm as it gathers data.
description: The same magic that sustains this island can be found lingering around the standing stones in the Shen'dar Highlands. Unfortunately, these are considered sacred sites and are under the direct protection of the Windshapers, which has made it difficult for us to study the magic present there.
With the Windshapers focused elsewhere, we have an opportunity to study the nature of this elemental magic.
Take this device to the standing stones and protect it as it gathers vital data. Be discreet, please.
data.partialDialogue: It's often difficult for me to establish a distinction between the Windshapers and the Al'Aketh, save that one is more overtly violent than the other. Equally dogmatic and slavish to their misplaced faith, they are both equally dangerous if left to their own devices.This is why our mission is so critical.
data.turnInDialogue: It would not have been my preference to spill Windshaper blood but the blame for this conflict rests solely on their shoulders. You were dispatched to peacefully gather information and they chose to engage in violence.Word has already spread and the Windshapers know what happened at the standing stones. They wouldn't dare to retaliate here in Valanaar, but they will certainly not forget.Bfg, you have been of tremendous aid to the High Order. I can easily see what Rathiril saw in you.

description: <Judging by what you've just found, its very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>
data.turnInDialogue: Th... thank you, stranger. I was walking down the road on my way back to Valanaar when a looming shadow appeared overhead. I turned to look and saw a massive, terrible beast bearing down at me from the sky. I tried to run, but I was hit hard and the world went black.I think its fair to say that if you hadn't come along, I'd have been dinner for that beast and its young.

data.objectivesText: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Dondallion Whisperwind in Valanaar.
description: I am feeling much better already. I have some skill with the arcane arts and we are but a short distance from Valanaar. I can make it on my own. More important than my safety however is how close to Valanaar these shrieklings have nested and the danger they pose. If you would be so kind, please head back inside and take the head of that beast!
After it's done, you'll find me with Dondallion back in Valanaar. I need to return to him as soon as possible. He's probably going to pieces with worry.
data.partialDialogue: That fool Fillion...
data.turnInDialogue: Well, I confess that I am intensely relieved that Fillion has returned to us. He never was good at minding his surroundings. Always too busy lost in thought, or with his nose in a book.Thank you, ‹class›.

description: You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but its obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.
You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.

I can only hope that whatever arcane solution the High Order finds can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. If you plan to go with them... well, his mission will be all the stronger for it.
Winds be with you, ‹name›.
data.turnInDialogue: It gladdens me to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.Ansirem has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between the city of Dalaran and Zephras Isle. We've done as much testing as we can, and the time has come for vanguard to depart.

data.objectivesText: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.
description: Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... its um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.
<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>
So er, um... how is your day going?
data.partialDialogue: So that's the story...
data.turnInDialogue: ...that's about all I have to say about it. I was--um--somewhere else before I was here. Now I'm here and I have my friends, and my things. T-things I built, I mean. That's about all I need. I think that's all I need, anyway.I have to say though, it is nice to talk to someone who will talk back. The forest spirits try, but they just end up singing at me. That's nice in its own way, but not exactly s-stimulating conversation.

data.objectivesText: Gather 8 Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.
description: I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!
So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!
data.partialDialogue: Mmm, I think you are going to like what I can cook up with these acorns!
data.turnInDialogue: Thank you, stranger! You'll find that these are delicious once roasted!Please excuse me, it won't take me long to whip this up.

data.objectivesText: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.
description: The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
data.partialDialogue: I will not rest until my fangs have gone through the throat of every single cultist on this isle.
data.turnInDialogue: Excellent work. Only good things can happen by eliminating the cult. Hopefully this sends a message that the Nightclaw are not to be trifled with and that our resentments run deep.I suspect you have your work cut out for yourself, taking on the cult. If you gather more ears bring them here.

data.objectivesText: Destroy 10 Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest.
description: Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but its definitely a song and its... just so sad.
I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?
data.partialDialogue: We can only hope that those poor spirits are able to find peace after being freed from this place.
data.turnInDialogue: Thank you, stranger.

data.objectivesText: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.
description: Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.

With all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.
Do be careful though, they are meaner than they look!
data.partialDialogue: Windsong Crawler meat is common enough here but it was something of a delicacy on the islands of Anvilas and Siroccas. Was a time, back when the skystreams were open that the locals would mob me for the stuff when I'd make the trip to Shen'dramar or New Eldre'naar.Not been able to visit those places in... well... a long time.
data.turnInDialogue: Winds bless me this meat looks fantastic!Thank you so much, ‹class›.

description: By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.
Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.
data.partialDialogue: I'll need the creature's head as proof of the deed.
data.turnInDialogue: If we didn't have enough on our plates between the cult and the highlands bandits, we don't need a giant vuldren terrorizing our citizens as well. You've done a great thing here today. As promised, here is your reward.
