data.objectivesText: Bring the head of Chol'aruk to Gur'ak in the Barrens.
description: You there, ‹class›. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.
Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.
Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.
Blood and thunder, ‹class›.
data.partialDialogue: It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.If these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the qullboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.
data.turnInDialogue: Impressive, ‹class›. None will doubt my tales when I return to Orgrimmar with this grim proof of the existence of these abominations. Rest assured this glory is yours however, and I will speak loudly of your deeds.Lok-tar!

data.objectivesText: Bring Chol'aruk's Head to Bainham in the Barrens.
description: There's rumors of a monstrous abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say its so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.
Few believe such tales, but I do... because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.
Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me it's head.
data.partialDialogue: It took six of us to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to kill all but myself and one other before we were able to bring it down.This far from alliance lands I should leave it well enough alone. Light knows I'll lose little sleep over a few tauren savages or orcish brutes. However, the honor of my fallen brothers demands action.
data.turnInDialogue: My dead men will rest easier knowing that there is one less of these monsters in the world. You've done well, and are a true and stalwart defender of the alliance. Thank you.Go with honor, Gryma.

data.objectivesText: Bring the Gatehouse Shipment to the stockroom entrance located in Trias' Cheese shop in the Trade District
description: Every day this week we've been short dockhands.
Care to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?

Take this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.
data.partialDialogue: You looking to fill a crate with our finest aged wheels?

data.objectivesText: Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.
description: All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.
data.partialDialogue: The Bloodtalon are known for their cunning and swiftness, and make fine companions when raised from egg to adult.Unfortunately adult raptors are very difficult to train, and I have tried to capture the Matriarch on more than one occasion. But she had become too dangerous of late.Still I hope to preserve her legacy by raising her children as companions here in Sen'Jin.
data.turnInDialogue: Thank you, Ashogg. I am happy we will be able to preserve her bloodline and raise them to be our allies. You have done a great service for our tribe.

data.objectivesText: Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
description: When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.
The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.
This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.
Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
data.partialDialogue: Have you found our loa idols, Enve? We must begin our rituals again soon.
data.turnInDialogue: You have done a great deed for our tribe today.Unlike some tribes, our kinship with our loa is one of reverence and respect, and we owe them much.I would not want the Darkspear to fall out of favor with them.

description: Are you here to discuss the deeper meanings of our storied legends? No?

Complimentary club refreshments on us, if you help us out.

description: Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.
He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
data.partialDialogue: We discover formulations and recipes by showing old ingredients to new generations, who experiment with it in their own way.
data.turnInDialogue: This type of cattail and speargrass is unique to Orgrimmar. Drinking from Azshara mountain spring water, and nourished by the sweat and blood soaked mineral dust of our rocky land, these herbs contain potent powers locked within.I'll give these to Yelmak, who may be able to win back Whuut's ear with a hands-on lesson.

data.objectivesText: Bring the Torch of Dormant Flame to Olariaan Swiftburn at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands.
description: Even though we are in the realm of skywall, this is still the elemental plane. The spirits of all four elements speak to us, if we deign to listen. One among us Windshapers is in particular attunement with the element of fire. A shen'dorei by the name of Olariaan Swiftburn.
Bring this to him at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands. You'll find it tucked away along the edge of the island, west of Valanaar.
data.partialDialogue: Yes, Nattyrav? What do you have there?
data.turnInDialogue: So you've brought the torch. Yes, young ‹class›, I can teach you to heed the call of fire. It will not be easy, but nothing that we do in this realm is ever easy.

data.objectivesText: Slay Skypriest Faladiel in the Gustberry Lowlands and collect Faladiel's Heart.
description: There is an Al'Aketh Skypriest called Faladiel. He was once a caller of the flame and a stalwart Windshaper. Like so many Al'Aketh, he mortgaged his loyalty for power and his hands are now stained with the blood of  his former brothers and sisters.

You will find Skypriest Faladiel at the farm to the northeast past Valanaar, just to the south of the Shrine of Akir. Kill the betrayer. Bring me his heart. It is a gruesome task, but it is needed for the ritual we are to perform.
data.partialDialogue: The heart of a betrayer is a powerful reagent. The flames will eagerly accept such an offering and burn more intensely as it is consumed.
data.turnInDialogue: The Windshapers do not forget, and blood is always paid with blood. It pleases me that you were able to deliver this final, painful reminder of our creed to this traitor.This heart will not be all that feeds the flames today, however. There is one other task that needs to done.

description: The residents of the Shen'dar Highlands speak of an ancient forest sprite called Kuramaa. They say it lives inside of a twisted stump at the summit of a hill near the highlands Anchor Pylon.
Go to the highlands and find this stump. Rap your fist upon the bark and Kuramaa will appear. Best the spirit in combat, and bring me its wooden mask.
Be warned however, this entity will be exceptionally resistant to much of your magic. Only the touch of flame will lay low the spirit.
data.partialDialogue: The spirit of Kuramaa is eternal, and it will manifest again when it is needed. It's mask is a source of great power, and will prove invaluable to the ritual we must complete.
data.turnInDialogue: We now have what we need. We will light the eternal flame and commune with the spirits of fire.

Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.
Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
data.turnInDialogue: Of course. Migi's parents and I have an arrangement to give Migi a bagged lunch every day, but I can only ensure the boy gets his food if he actually comes in to pick it up.Sometimes, he doesn't pick up his meal multiple times a week, and I wonder where he gets the energy to stay out and play.

data.objectivesText: Bring Migi's Lunch to him behind Grommash Hold
description: Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea.

They made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily.
Take this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
data.partialDialogue: I think we can win this one...
data.turnInDialogue: Borstan's Meats? Is that for one of us?Oh!Wow... this smells really good! Yummy.Thanks for bringing me my lunch. I can tell what Borstan is going to be serving daily when my friends and I walk the road to Grommash Hold, by the smells alone. This tastes like my favorite, the sweetglaze! But it's different. I like the strong flavored crumbs.If it's going to be this tasty every day, I think we need to stop our game to take our lunch together!

data.objectivesText: Slay Alliance soldiers encroaching into the Barrens at the border to Dustwallow Marsh, then return to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.
description: Traveler, have you plans to head toward Dustwallow Marsh? I have heard mutterings that a few human soldiers have taken a stand at its border and are toppling the landmarks left behind by our tauren pathfinders.

Rumor has it that a favored tavern has burned to the ground, and in typical Alliance fashion, they immediately cast their blame onto the Horde! I cannot know whether there is any truth to their claim, but their incursion onto OUR land must not stand.
Kill first, investigate later!
data.turnInDialogue: So the rumors were true! I expected as much, tensions have been rising along the eastern coast for some time. I knew it would only be a matter of time before conflict crept into our territory.However, I am skeptical that we played a role in the tavern's destruction. Too many Horde civilians rely on that route for trade and travel. Perhaps you could investigate further if you find the time.In any case, today's deed is a victory for the Horde, and a stern warning to the Alliance!

So, apparently, nobody I've sent to deal with the recent pirate problem has come back alive. After five or six attempts I thought, "what if I sent a machine instead?" Turns out, scimitars double as screwdrivers in a pinch, and before I could redirect it home, it was already in pieces and scattered across their camp!
I need those parts back, and since this is a quick little retrieval mission, I'd wager your odds for survival are MUCH higher than the others. Whaddya say?

data.turnInDialogue: Whooooa! Nice one, pal! You saved me from another one of Gagsprocket's unbearable lectures on the cost of metal. More importantly, I can jump right into building my next prototype.Uhhh, I didn't have a reward planned... Do you like boxes?

data.objectivesText: Give Yelmak's Potion to Whuut.
description: Whuut is a prodigy. That much is true. But he doesn't yet have the experience, wisdom, and time on the stirring rod to know how to respect alchemical processes.
He is exhausting all of the rarest and most exotic reagents we have available without pausing to practice and refine his basic skills.
Give him this potion I've brewed with a quick tonic method. He'll reconsider everything he's doing when he learns how local remedies and careful touch are the first true mastery.
data.partialDialogue: Alright, what's next... Black Lotus, Mountain Silversage...
data.turnInDialogue: Grorru--whaa?You say Yelmak made this potion from speargrass and cattail with no other reagents? There could be a lot I'm missing out on by skipping to the most rare and least-studied flora first.Drakath, take your pick from one of these potions I brewed earlier. data.objectivesText: Find Grund and Gozwin's camp in the hills to the northwest. Recover Gozwin's Mechanic's Log and kill the Snow Leopard Prowler.
description: Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!

Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.
Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.
Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!

data.objectivesText: Purchase a Bundle of Herbs from Nida the herbalist, a Bundle of Ceder Twigs from Nata the enchanting supplier, and Sinew Thread from Mahu the leatherworking supplier and Ceremonial Flint and Tinder from Naal the cooking supplier.
description: Blessings of An'she, friend.
We tauren have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds and I was hoping you'd be interested in honoring this tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.
You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
data.partialDialogue: There are many occasions one may choose to spread incense to the winds. You could be asking the Earthmother to watch over someone, bless a hunt, celebrate an occasion, or even to seek guidance from our ancestors.Or it could be something else entirely.Though the act is done with reverence, it is not strictly a ceremonial affair. Typically there are certain traditional steps observed when performing this act, but many tribes have differing practices.
data.turnInDialogue: You have done well.I thank you for taking the time to perform one of our time-honored traditions, ‹race›. I hope that as you travel you will find plenty of occasions you wish to give thanks for.Should you ever wish to perform the ritual again, you should be able to repurchase the components I sent you to collect.Go with An'she's warmth.

data.objectivesText: Bring Shelene Rhobart 8 Duskbat Wing Membranes, 6 Darkhound Hides and 3 Vile Fin Murloc Skin.
description: One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?
Well, it doesn't.
Ours is a cursed life, ‹name›. We must take from the living to further our own existence.
When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!
Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.
data.partialDialogue: Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.It may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.Similarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.
data.turnInDialogue: Ah, excellent! Thank you for acquiring these. I can promise they will be put to good use.

data.objectivesText: Speak with Taleen Shimmerthread in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
description: Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
data.turnInDialogue: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

data.objectivesText: Collect 4  Gnarlpine Totems and bring them to Tarindrella.
description: The Gnarlpine furbolg would not turn on their ancient allies so readily. We must learn more of their plight.
Search their abandoned homes for totems. If any survived the chaos of their departure, their engravings may tell us more of what happened here.
You'll find their camps along the western edge of the glen, though the grell and grellkin may have scattered them beyond.
data.partialDialogue: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!
data.turnInDialogue: Oh, it's even worse than I thought.These engravings tell us that the Gnarlpine began having nightmares of being wiped out by some great shadow. Before long, that fear turned to rage--and the shadow to their former elven friends. To be aware of your own mind slipping away from you...Our only hope is that this may help us better understand what is happening on Teldrassil. Thank you for your aid, Django.

data.objectivesText: Cast Elune's Light and Shadowmeld.
description: You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.
Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.
Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.
data.turnInDialogue: You have seen what our goddess provides. Use it well, and she will never forsake you.

description: Steel yourself for your time in the ruins, young one... you will not be granted free passage there.
Scores of cursed Highborne, now known as naga, roam the once great city. Travel northeast and dispatch them from this land.
What they once were... is no more. If they aid the Twilight's Hammer, they can bring only further pain to the forests that once gave them shelter.
War is what they seek, ‹class›. War... is what we will bring.
data.turnInDialogue: Do not fret, young one. To pillage one's own home for some dark master...It is unforgivable.

data.objectivesText: Report To Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.
description: If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, I'd recommend reporting to a man named Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall to the south, at the settlement known as Sentinel Hill. His people are in need of aid.

After journeying here from another plane of existence, the problems our lands face may seem small. I assure you, the aid you provide to those impacted by such problems means everything to them, and you will grow stronger for your labors.
Good luck out there, adventurer!
data.turnInDialogue: I've been begging Stormwind for aid for months and he sends me a skinny elf? Well, beggars can't be choosers I suppose.Welcome to Westfall, ‹class›. Let's see if we can't put you to work.

data.objectivesText: Report To Thork at The Crossroads in The Barrens.
description: After journeying here from the elemental plane, the problems our lands face may seem small. Rest assured, the dangers the horde faces are very real, and you will grow formidable should you survive your service.

If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, travel southwest to the vast lands known as the Barrens. There is a settlement there known as the Crossroads. The proud citizens there are ever in need of aid.
Go with honor, adventurer!
data.turnInDialogue: What's this? An elf? And you say the Warchief sent you?<Thork grunts sharply as he looks you up and down.>You look a little skinny to me, but it matters not. Out here you'll either thrive and survive, or you'll die. That is the way of things in these lands.

data.objectivesText: Find and slay the owl known as Jai'vhanel and take one of her feathers. The black owl was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Report the death of Jai'vhanel to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
description: Attention!
A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also know as "Swordfeather".
Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.
Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.
Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
The Auberdine Village Council
data.partialDialogue: Greetings ‹class› - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
data.turnInDialogue: It is good to know that issue has been taken care of, but it saddens me that we could not find another way. Jai'vhanel had been somewhat of a guardian of this area for quite some time, and I am not sure what could have caused her decent into madness.Regardless, thank you for your service today, ‹class›. The roads to Auberdine are safe for travel once again.

data.objectivesText: Bring the Clouded Water Globe to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
description: All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.
Whatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.
Only Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.
data.partialDialogue: I can sense something far older than you in my presence, ‹race›... what have you brought me?
data.turnInDialogue: <Onu appears surprised--or as surprised as an ancient can appear.>Stairs descending down in Mathystra? Could be it be?<Onu shakes his head.>I must confer with the others on this. For now, know that it is good you uncovered this before the naga... or their cult allies.Please accept this as thanks for your efforts. It is no small feat to defeat an elemental guardian.

Perhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it.
<Fandral looks away, no longer speaking to you.>
I must look elsewhere if this is to work...

description: You must bring this to Tyrande at once! I will transfer it to a more ceremonial container for you.
Do not be afraid. The High Priestess of Elune is firm, but kind. She protects all who enter Darnassus, and carries our goddess' light to all.
She will be glad to receive this sacred water. You will find her directly above us.
data.partialDialogue: Please state your business. I have a city to run, and a people to lead.
data.turnInDialogue: Staghelm has done much in my beloved's absence, but he is not Malfurion. And he does not run the affairs of Darnassus--that burden is mine alone.<Tyrande's face settles.>I apologize. As you have likely seen, we have many challenges to overcome.Fandral is Arch Druid for now, and I ask you respect his station. But his doings pertain to druidism, and mine not only to Elune but indeed to lead our people as she wills.Every drop of this water is blessed by our goddess. I thank you for saving it.

description: General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.
Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.

Crocs of the sky, I call 'em! There's no way my apprentice could get them--but it seems right up your alley!

data.objectivesText: Sulhasa in southern Barrens wants you to clear out 7 Stormhide lizards and 7 Hecklefang Stalkers in the area so she can leave the tree safely.
description: I'm so glad you saw me!

The weather was lovely this morning, so I walked from Camp Taurajo down the golden road. When it came time to head back, I couldn't--a pack of hyenas started circling, and Stormhide lizards blocked my only escape.
Scrambling up this tree I went, and now there are too many foes about at this hour for me to make the run home through the fields.
Would you mind clearing out these Stormhide and Hecklefang Stalkers for me?
data.turnInDialogue: Thank you for helping me out, Illbean. I'll let Camp Taurajo know you were able to rescue me. I'm so lucky you helped, I could have been stuck there all day!This is all I have to spare, but I hope it's useful to you.I'll be making my exit once I make the careful climb down.

So many lives lost...
What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!
Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.

data.objectivesText: Recover Nord'el for Sylessa Duskwhisper in Menethil Harbor.
description: I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.

description: <A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel."
Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
data.partialDialogue: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
data.turnInDialogue: You have arrived at the right place! I am happy to mark you down as one of our affiliates. No contracts to sign and no commitments to weigh you down. All we ask of you is your diligence to assist in completing or returning any of our deliveries you find on your travels.When you do so, you will be compensated with Merchant's Favor that will allow you to purchase goods and services we offer here. In fact, here's a little bit to get you started.Now, do you happen to have the crate this came from?

I'm so angry. They said Ashenvale was easy to follow. Easy for who? The beasts? The birds?
One moment I was gathering an herb, the next I'm trapped in this ravine. Do I truly have to circle half the forest to reach where I stood just moments ago?
When I'm like this, my spells grow volatile and behave... differently.
Could you thin the wildlife nearby? Even their stupid hooves grate on me. I despise this cursed forest.

data.objectivesText: Bring 6 Worgen Bits to Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.
description: Ah, it's all become so embarrassingly clear! Arugal hardly had any magic at all, let alone enough to create the worgen. 'Arugal's Curse.' Pah! Barely potent enough to last a few seconds.
These shackles prove he can bind the beasts, not create them. The worgen clearly spread their curse a different way. I would know how.
Go to the Greymane Wall to the south. The worgen seem to be spreading to the humans nearby. Tear the beasts apart and bring me whatever you find. This requires a more direct approach.
data.partialDialogue: Fangs, claws, gizzards. It makes no difference to me. The easiest way to study something is to see the guts yourself.
data.turnInDialogue: It appears I get the last laugh after all, haha! Arugal truly was a fool. And I, Dalar Dawnweaver, have exposed him as the fraud he is.These pieces are all the proof I need that the curse has nothing to do with that blithering dolt.Regrettably, that means his remedy is also worth nothing. It seems the search for a solution to the worgen curse continues.

While I research a way to stop the curse, our first priority is to contain it. It appears this affliction cannot infect forsaken, but a large group of humans have gathered by the Greymane Wall.

description: Hoha! Good to see a ‹race› who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!
Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.
data.partialDialogue: Wendigos are nasty beasties. Its just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece!
data.turnInDialogue: Now that's more like it! With these shipments we'll get the forge back up and runnin' in no time!

description: Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.
Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.
If you're already going to be out and about, what say you don't check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!
data.turnInDialogue: Ol' Whitebeard sent ya, aye?I got his report, alright. This whole situation's a mess!

data.objectivesText: Slay Frosthowl and collect the Sack of Fish for Gretta Ganter in Brewnall Village
description: Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it.

Well, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway.
Do us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast.
data.partialDialogue: It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo.
data.turnInDialogue: Yer a real lifesaver, Leif!My husband would just laugh it off, but I couldn't bare tellin' him he has to spend another night on the lake. Maybe now we can enjoy a real feast.

data.objectivesText: Seek out the Avatar of Saeyleenan in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the windborne cat.
description: A spirit of your homeland has recently appeared here and has asked me to guide you to it. This windborne cat spirit has come to tutor and mentor you so that you may take the feline shape of the spirit on Zephras.

All druids eventually seek this wisdom, though it seems your homeland has a slightly different shape than our traditional one. If you desire to take this spirit's feline form, you will need to undergo our trial.
It can be found in the southern part of Moonglade, south of the twin bridges.
data.turnInDialogue: Greetings, young shen'dorei. I have come to you because I sense you are ready to undertake the trial to determine if you understand my spiritual nature or not.I will have you take the trial of the Great Cat Spirit of Azeroth, but as you are from Zephras, I wished to oversee your progress myself. After all, it is my shape you would take, not that of a Azerothian cat spirit.Let us begin.

data.turnInDialogue: Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.I now deem you worthy of my blessing, young ‹class›.

description: The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Turak Runetotem, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.
Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
data.turnInDialogue: Welcome back, Cory. I can sense you have met with the Great Cat Spirit and have successfully completed the trial. All druids must pass a trial given by this spirit, though the trials vary by generation. I am proud you have passed and have heeded the wisdom of the Great Cat Spirit. It is an ancient spirit that is as deadly as it is playful, though I can sense you understand the spirit's nature already.I will now instruct you on how to take the shape of the cat.

description: Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!

If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.
Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.
data.turnInDialogue: The mill is that bad? That's worse than I thought.I'm not particularly squeamish, but work's bad enough without spiders snatching up my workers. Thanks for the help,Raton!

data.objectivesText: Bring 10 Battleworn Axes to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
description: What the Blackrock orcs don't understand is that this is a war of attrition. Their brazen push into Alliance territory has left them vulnerable and without supplies, relying on the surrounding mountains to gather resources.

An army can't run on empty bellies, ‹name›. Go to their encampments south of Stonewatch Keep to the east and rob them of their food and weapons. Let's see the orcs' fighting spirit when they're starved and defenseless.
data.partialDialogue: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
data.turnInDialogue: Excellent work, Eraina. With the Blackrock orcs cut off from their allies in the Burning Steppes, they will have no hope of maintaining their foothold here without proper supplies.

data.objectivesText: Free 6 Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.
description: Greetings, ‹class›. Yes, I am a paladin. Not even death can stop the Light.
This my kind have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but I am not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.
data.turnInDialogue: May this help Executor Arren and so many others see our true nature. Much like in our past lives, we live to serve our people--to protect them with the gifts the Light provides us.They will see in time that we are just as valuable to the Dark Lady's plans as any other.Light be with you.

description: Blessings to you, ‹class›. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.
We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.

description: Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.
He has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.
Dispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.
data.partialDialogue: <Tallonkai lowers his voice.>Does Xethorr still walk freely?
data.turnInDialogue: I should have known this was being used to twist the spiders of this land.I have heard whispers of this substance being the source of much of the corruption plaguing us. Though this is not the original, it is an older sample and may yield more information than what we have obtained so far.Normally I would have you send this to Darnassus for further study. However, it is best we kept this quiet for the moment, or Dolanaar will never recover its reputation.I trust you to do the same.

The beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.

The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
data.partialDialogue: What have you brought from the depths, ‹class›.
data.turnInDialogue: Ah yes, my ancestor Madoran was the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge following the great civil war between the Wildhammer, Bronzebeard, and Dark Iron clans. data.objectivesText: Help Perith Stormhoof escape Palemane Rock, and report his safety to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
description: Hail, ‹class›. What brings you deep into such a dark and violent place?

I was sent here by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof as a part of our efforts to communicate with the gnolls that have taken residence. The rest of my mission must remain a secret, as do all things with the Longwalkers, the trusted scouts of our chieftain.
All you must know is our diplomacy was met with violence, and I fear I may be tonight's feast for the gnolls if you do not help me escape.
Are you up to the task?
data.turnInDialogue: I am relieved that Longwalker Stormhoof is well. He is my most trusted scout, and his mission of the utmost importance.Please, accept my thanks and my hospitality for riskng your life to save his own. You have done a greater service to our people than you know.I encourage you to explore our great city while you are here. It is a place of safety, and you will find many that may aid you on your own travels upon its bluffs.Ish-ne-alo por-ah.

data.objectivesText: Deliver Tom's Gift to Bart Tidewater in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
description: Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!
"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!
If you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.
There's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!
And he cheats at poker!
data.partialDialogue: Put yer backs into it! We set sail on my word!Oh? What's that you have there, traveler?
data.turnInDialogue: <Bart unwraps the gift.>Why that no good, son of a--Did he even tell you that HE is the one who cheats at poker?! I only won enough money to buy the Maiden's Virtue after we kicked him out of our poker circle!I swear, the next time I see that absolute waste of seawater--I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I shouldn't shoot the messenger. On behalf of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue--finest ship in the Great Sea--welcome to Menethil Harbor!

My dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.
<Hollee sighs, then her brow furrows slightly.>
Sorry, and his wife... Merrin.
It doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.

data.objectivesText: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Glix Xizzix in the Undercity.
description: Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.
You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.
<Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>
data.partialDialogue: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.
data.turnInDialogue: Thanks for delivering this, pal.Wait... he said I'd tip you? I didn't agree to that!Fine. Take your pick of this junk in the lost and found. You'd be surprised how many of these Forsaken leave their stuff laying around after getting haircuts. There's a joke here about them being brainless, but I suspect in a lot of cases it might actually be true.

data.partialDialogue: Ah, another ‹race› comin' ta learn about the Light! You'll find that deepening your connection to the Light relies on curiosity and intelligence, qualities that many gnomes have in abundance. The way o' the Light isn't a technical discipline, it's a riddle, and one that provides both life lessons and practical blessings.

As you deepen your connection with the Light, you can come back to me to talk about what you've learned. I'll be happy to show you how to tap into that force to teach ya how to heal, or to smite the wicked. For a small donation, of course!

description: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, ‹name›.

I usually avoid dealing with warlocks if I can help it, but I think you should read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from your newly-appointed trainer, Nartok. He would have words with you when you're ready.
data.partialDialogue: Ah, you received my message. Excellent. We orcs have a long and turbulent history with the entities of the Nether, but now we forge our own path, in command of our destiny. You, too, can seize the power to shape the future for your people. Where our leaders falter, we are ready to press forward and claim our rightful place. You will be of eminence among the trolls.
data.turnInDialogue: You have just glimpsed the power that can be yours. The feeble and foolish among us are afraid of the path that we tread, but with boldness and cunning we can decide our own fates.Guard your powers closely. The fearful lash out against that which they do not understand.Now you are one of us. If you need training in spells then return to me.

Go to their camp now, before they have rested and have a chance to ride to our village. Slaughter them all. Ensure none escape to the Barrens to rally others to their aid.
If you find the leader of this would-be raiding party, bring me his head so that it may serve as a warning to others who dare tread on our ancestral homeland.
data.partialDialogue: Is the deed done?
data.turnInDialogue: You are covered in centaur blood. Remember this feeling. It is an honor unlike any other among our people.I could hear the moment the last fell, and their thunderous stampede echoed no longer. Well done!Today marks a great victory for our village, and a security our young ones need now more than ever. You have my deepest thanks, young ‹class›.

data.objectivesText: Seek audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
description: Your bravery defending your people demands recognition. Journey to Thunder Bluff to the northwest, our mighty city whose shadow grants us shade in the warmer months, and seek audience with my father.

It was he who led the charge with the young Warchief Thrall to reclaim these plains and drive the centaur away for good. As High Chieftain, he will reward you generously for your part in ensuring his own bravery is honored.
You must take a lift to reach the High Chieftain, who sits on the central rise.
data.turnInDialogue: The Galak centaur dare show themselves in Mulgore?!You have brought pride to your ancestors by driving them out. Perhaps that will remind them of the pain that awaits them should they do so again!Please accept this gift in honor of this. May it serve you well as you venture out into the Earth Mother's kingdom, to the far reaches of this world.

description: Hail, young ‹class›. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.
Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.
Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.

There's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away.
And some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... truly a win-win.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.
Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.

They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!
<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>
I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.

data.objectivesText: Collect 6 Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.
description: While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.
I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.
Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.
data.partialDialogue: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.

data.objectivesText: Collect the rifles of fallen mountaineers.
description: Even mountaineers from Ironforge have to keep their wits about them when traversing through the peaks of Dun Morogh. Falling snow and ice often spells the end of some more novice members' lives.

After a slide, I usually try to find any sign of survivors or victims--while praying to the Light that there's nothing to be found. But with the elements acting up, I've held off wandering too far. If you could look for some lost mountaineers and bring me their rifles, I will return them to Ironforge.
data.partialDialogue: What do you need?
data.turnInDialogue: The mountaineers engrave their names on the stock of their rifles. It helps identify them should something happen. I'll send these back to Ironforge--there someone will pass them on to any family.

description: I was tasked to retrieve important data on the flow of elemental energy from the Overlook Standing Stones. That data is vital to our plans to safely travel between Skywall and Azeroth. data.objectivesText: Discover the fate of Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, and bring either him or his surveying equipment to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.
description: Oh, this is just terrible!  I sent out my top assistant, Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, into the desert southeast of here.  That's an area we call the Gaping Chasm.  Well, he's gone missing, and his last report had more of those weird bugs where he was.  Could it be that they've infested two major regions of the desert now?
I need you to head into the Gaping Chasm and look for Scrimshank, please!  That... or at least find his surveying equipment.  I fear that may be all that is left of the poor sod.
data.partialDialogue: Well, what news do you have?  You look like you've been in quite the fight... is Scrimshank alive?
data.turnInDialogue: He was a good goblin, young Scrimshank.  Let's hope that his demise was not in vain by what he was able to record with his surveying equipment.It seems as though we have quite the situation on our hands here with these bugs.  They're way too cunning for their own good, and the research we've done so far is shaping up to indicate that they might even be under the controlling influence of a third party!  If this is the case, then it bodes ill for not only Gadgetzan, but the whole desert!

description: The Blackrock orcs have travelled from the Burning Steppes and claimed Stonewatch Keep to the north.  From there they maraud the areas north of Lakeshire and keep its citizens in town, penned like cattle.

data.objectivesText: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
description: ‹name›, I have been following your progress with much delight.  You are most assuredly developing yourself into a valued protector of nature.

The time has come for you to learn more about one of the various animal aspects that Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to change into - one that affords you command and mastery of the water.  For this, you must travel to the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle there.  He will guide you further.
data.turnInDialogue: Salutations, young ‹class›; the time has come for you to know our aquatic form. It is one that lets you move freely and indefinitely through water. You will find this aspect a useful tool and a blessing... but it is one that must be earned before it is mastered.You will face two trials to overcome. The first will test your ability to work in water under pressure. The second will test your resolve to understand the aspects of the form itself.Stand ready, as the time of testing is now upon us.

data.objectivesText: Find a Shrine Bauble in Lake Elune'ara, and take it to the Shrine of Remulos in northwestern Moonglade.  Once there, use the Shrine Bauble.
description: For your first trial, search the depths of Lake Elune'ara to locate a Shrine Bauble.  It decays rapidly, so proceed with it to the Shrine of Remulos post haste.  Use the bauble at the shrine, and then speak with Tajarri there; she is one of Moonglade's most trusted wardens.

You only have a set amount of time to complete the task, and you may be competing against other druids searching for baubles themselves.  Mental and physical dexterity will be critical to your success.
Good luck, ‹name›.
data.turnInDialogue: Well now. It looks like yet another ‹race› has successfully completed the Trial of the Lake! Well done, my young friend - well done.As I've said, my name is Tajarri. It is my duty and my privilege to serve as a warden for Moonglade, and specifically this shrine. Keeper Remulos guides the Cenarion Circle in preservation of nature and balance, and his shrine serves as a lasting tribute to such. By using the bauble here, it serves as a nod to the importance of this place within the Circle.

Keeper Remulos guides the Cenarion Circle in preservation of nature and balance, and his shrine serves as a lasting tribute to such. By using the bauble here, it serves as a nod to the importance of this place within the Circle.

data.objectivesText: Find the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance.  Speak with the residents of Moonglade to learn clues as to where these items may be located.
description: For the second trial, you'll need the two halves that make the Pendant of the Sea Lion.  One half draws power from the agility of the sea lion aspect, gliding through water; the other draws power from the incredible endurance of the sea lion aspect.  Druids draw on both these traits equally to embody the aspect of their aquatic form.
Speak with the locals of Moonglade to learn where the parts may lie, and bring both here to join them together.  Once formed, take the pendant to Dendrite Starblaze.
data.partialDialogue: Have you formed your pendant for me to inspect, ‹name›? If you need help in locating the parts, try asking the local populace for information. Not only will you find what you seek, but it will give you a reason to explore this wondrous and sacred glade.
data.turnInDialogue: You've completed the Trial of the Sea Lion, ‹name› - congratulations.Each task in acquiring the pendant shows that both agility and endurance are necessary to act in harmony with what you desire to do underwater. Neither can exist without the other, and both cannot be done without your willingness to embrace the aspect of the sea lion.Remember these lessons well, and count on them once you have gained your aquatic form.

Show him your pendant and prove to him you are ready to learn what he has to teach you.  He will complete your training, allowing you to become one with the water.

data.objectivesText: Defeat the Corrupt Manifestation of Water and place the Corrupted Manifestation's Bracers along with the Remaining Drops of Purest Water on the Brazier of Everfount in Silverpine Forest.
description: Along the coast of Silverpine, west of the Sepulcher, you will find a shrine that has become tainted by the plague. The spirits there no longer speak to our people and it will be up to you to defeat the manifestation and cleanse the pool.
Take the elemental's bracers, along with the remaining drops of Brine's potion, and place them on the brazier. The ritual should be enough to summon a pure spirit for you to communicate with.
Bring me proof the task is done, and I will reward you with your totem.
data.partialDialogue: The brazier still reflects the ambient light from the area, and the flame shifts slightly as you move closer.The corruption along the hills seems to have kept its distance, and besides the missing components, the brazier looks prepared for the ritual to summon a cleansed manifestation of water.
data.turnInDialogue: You place the bracers atop the brazier and then pour the remaining drops of Brine's potion into the flame. The drops crackle as they hit the flame and you begin to incant the simple words Islen taught you....

data.objectivesText: Bring five Centipaar insect parts from the Noxious Lair to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
description: All right now, these reports about the bugs... what we know is that they are draining the water pools that used to be where the Noxious Lair is. What we DON'T know is, well, everything else.

Let's figure out who our enemy is first! I want you to head into the Noxious Lair and get some parts off of those critters. Get five from the Centipaar there and bring them to Alchemist Pestlezugg for him to dink with. With him on the case, we'll figure out what they are!
data.partialDialogue: You're Junior Surveyor ‹name›, yes? Quickly now, there is a dire situation at hand! Do you have the insect parts that Fizzledowser said you would?!
data.turnInDialogue: Good work - I'll start my analysis on these now! I can tell you right from the start though... these are nothing like any insect form I have ever seen. It's almost as if these bugs are being controlled by an outside force or something.You need to go talk to Fizzledowser right away; apparently there is an emergency that he needs your help with on the double! I'm not sure, but I think it involves more of the bugs in the Tanaris desert!

data.objectivesText: Bring the Shard of Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.
description: Take shard. Take shard and give life.
Give life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.
You protect and give life with water's power.
data.partialDialogue: You've returned. Splendid!How went your journey to Silverpine? Did it take you long?It is hard for me to tell if you were successful there because so much of the land has become corrupt. Its stench overwhelms any good that you might have done. But small successes are sometimes as important as large ones. Purifying the water there was instrumental for you, and for all shamans.
data.turnInDialogue: This is the proof I asked for. You've done well, ‹name›.I am pleased to be the first to congratulate you and give you this... your water totem.Use it well, and good luck.Your next test will not be for some time, so learn your lessons well. Pure water will not only give life back to those who are injured, but can have many other effects. I suggest you seek out a shaman trainer when you have the time. They might have other spells for you to learn.

description: Alas, the time to attack Andorhal and drive out the lich that controls it is upon us!

Inside the ruins of the city is where the lich - Araj the Summoner - holds dominion.  He is guarded by numerous Scourge surrounding the remains of city's center, and his personal retinue of guardians attached to him directly is formidable.  You will need numerous allies to even stand a chance of facing him successfully.
Destroy Araj, ‹name›, and bring me a shard from his phylactery as proof!

Your bravery and perseverance are a testament to what it means to be a true hero. Please - accept this as a token for all to see and know that you have delivered the Horde a victory for the ages!

data.objectivesText: Deliver the report to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.  Be sure he gives you a copy of the report, as Alchemist Pestlezugg has requested.
description: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser needs to see this report immediately.  Actually... everyone who can read needs to see this report.  We are facing a grave and serious threat to not only Tanaris and Gadgetzan, but if left unchecked, the entirety of southern Kalimdor.  Heck, even quite possible the whole of Azeroth; this thing has given no indication it will subside.
Have Fizzledowser make a duplicate of the report for you to distribute freely to your allegiance. Everyone must know about this threat!
data.partialDialogue: Well Junior Surveyor ‹name›, has ol' Pestlezugg got that report ready yet?
data.turnInDialogue: Thank you for delivering the report, Junior Surveyor ‹name›; here is your pay for your diligent service to the Gadgetzan Water Company.While I am usually not thrilled about handing out our valuable information carte blanche to those who would otherwise pay good coin for it, I've known Pestlezugg for a number of years now. data.objectivesText: Take Shaw's report to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.
description: The Stonemasons' Guild was run by a man named Edwin VanCleef.  VanCleef was responsible for rebuilding Stormwind after the orcs razed it in the First War.  Apparently, VanCleef and his men were unhappy with their treatment by the King after the reconstruction was complete.  That just might explain a thing or two.
I have written a more detailed account for your Master in Westfall.  Take this to him at once!

data.turnInDialogue: Edwin VanCleef. . .I know the name well. To think that a man so industrious and talented could turn into such a scoundrel unnerves me. I'll need further proof before I believe this.

data.objectivesText: Return your ward to the Stormwind orphanage by handing in the Human Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Nightingale in the Cathedral District.

I don't wanna be sad about what's happened to me and all - my folks always told me to rise above anything bad that happens.  You know, when I grow up I wanna be a hero... just like you.
I'm sad to say this, but it's time for me to go home.  Let's go back and I'll tell the matron what an awesome person you are!

data.objectivesText: Bring the Mind's Eye to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
description: Kurzen may be dead, but...that which drove him to evil still lives!  Through my studies I have discovered this: An Ogre Mage - Mai'Zoth - dwells in an Ogre Mound within the eastern mountains of Stranglethorn.  He is rumored to employ mind-controlling magic, and I am positive that he corrupted Kurzen.
If Mai'Zoth is allowed to live, then his evil may influence others, and may even cause another Kurzen to surface.
Kill him, and bring me his Mind's Eye, the artifact he uses to corrupt others.
data.partialDialogue: I give you my blessing. Mai'Zoth's strength is matched only by his evil.
data.turnInDialogue: Aha! You've done it! You are a great force for good, ‹name›, and may your strength never fade!I will study this Mind's Eye and determine if it may be used for good. If not... then it must be destroyed.

data.objectivesText: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to bring him the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
description: ‹name›, you are a hunter worthy of our company.  From the battlefields of Lordaeron to the deepest jungle, I have rarely witnessed such prowess with weaponry as you have demonstrated.

You have killed the ferocious Sin'Dall, the elusive Bag'thera and the treacherous Tethis.  But the true prize is the head of King Bangalash.  That white tiger is the reason I am here.  I've had my sights on him for quite some time now.  Kill King Bangalash and your hunting prowess is proven to be second to none.
data.partialDialogue: I see you're back, old bloke. King Bangalash has caused me to come crawling back to camp many times. Hang in there.
data.turnInDialogue: Bloody well done! Right-o! Congratulations, ‹name›, for succeeding where others have failed.I am honored to count you as a comrade of our great hunting party here. No one will ever doubt your expertise in hunting and tracking!Cheers to you, I say! Cheers!

data.objectivesText: Bring Araj's Phylactery Shard to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
description: Alas, the time to attack Andorhal and drive out the lich that controls it is upon us!

Inside the ruins of the city is where the lich - Araj the Summoner - holds dominion.  He is guarded by numerous Scourge surrounding the remains of city's center, and his personal retinue of guardians attached to him directly is formidable.  You will need numerous allies to even stand a chance of facing him successfully.
Destroy Araj, ‹name›, and bring me a shard from his phylactery as proof!
data.partialDialogue: Your task has been given to you, ‹name›. Do you have a shard from the lich's phylactery as proof of the task being accomplished?
data.turnInDialogue: You've done it! Araj... the lich is finally defeated!You've done a tremendous service to the Alliance on this day, ‹name›. Your bravery and perseverance are a testament to what it means to be a true hero. Please - accept this as a token for all to see and know that you have delivered the Alliance a victory for the ages!

data.objectivesText: Take the purchase order to Alessandro Luca in the Undercity.
description: The Royal Apothecary Society needs your assistance.  Listen closely, and both of us may profit from my plan.

Apothecary Keever in the next room may be... touched... but his research does potentially bear fruit if it were pursued by a clever researcher.  Fortunately, I am such a researcher.  I want you to take this purchase order to Alessandro Luca, the proprietor of Blue Moon Odds and Ends; he'll give you a testing kit.  When you have it, bring it back to me and I'll outline your task in detail.
data.partialDialogue: Yes, and what may I assist you with?  Are you here on business for the Royal Apothecary Society, or have you arrived here merely to brighten my day?
data.turnInDialogue: Ah, Zinge needs a kit, does she?  It saddens me that Zinge does not choose to grace myself with her sweet presence.Very well, let me procure a kit for you.

data.objectivesText: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
description: Attention, young adventurers!  The wilds of Ashenvale await you!

The Horde has established a strong presence in the lands north of the Barrens.  Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the Horde!  Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there.  Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the Barrens, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of Ashenvale!
data.turnInDialogue: Welcome to the new frontier, ‹name›. Ashenvale is a land of opportunity, one where a young ‹class› like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle. Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the Horde has another outpost there as well.Your presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt. Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.

Well, don't just stand there.  Such is the life of a simple courier, yes?
data.partialDialogue: Yes, I think Luca is as disturbing as you do. It matters not - hand me the field sampling kit. I will need to make some adjustments to it in order to survey for the proper base materials.You have the kit, don't you?

data.objectivesText: Find the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance.  Speak with the residents of Moonglade to learn clues as to where these items may be located.
description: For the second trial, you'll need the two halves that make the Pendant of the Sea Lion.  One half draws power from the agility of the sea lion aspect, gliding through water; the other draws power from the incredible endurance of the sea lion aspect.  Druids draw on both these traits equally to embody the aspect of their aquatic form.
Speak with the locals of Moonglade to learn where the parts may lie, and bring both here to join them together.  Once formed, take the pendant to Dendrite Starblaze.
data.partialDialogue: Have you formed your pendant for me to inspect, ‹name›? If you need help in locating the parts, try asking the local populace for information. Not only will you find what you seek, but it will give you a reason to explore this wondrous and sacred glade.
data.turnInDialogue: You've completed the Trial of the Sea Lion, ‹name› - congratulations.Each task in acquiring the pendant shows that both agility and endurance are necessary to act in harmony with what you desire to do underwater. Neither can exist without the other, and both cannot be done without your willingness to embrace the aspect of the sea lion.Remember these lessons well, and count on them once you have gained your aquatic form.

data.objectivesText: Bring the Lich's Spellbook to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
description: There is a lich who dwells on the island in Brightwater Lake to the north.  Although he is a free-willed Forsaken, he believes all other Undead are Scourge slaves and has his minions attack anyone who approaches him.
But because he is Forsaken, the Queen will want him.  And if he is skilled in Necromancy, then his knowledge would be...quite useful to us.
To discover his identity and his talents, I must see his spellbook.  Steal into his camp and acquire it, then return to me.
data.partialDialogue: ‹name›, have you acquired the book?
data.turnInDialogue: Very good, ‹name›. I will study this book and determine the identity of that lich. You have served your Queen well.<Bethor opens the book and stares intently at its glowing pages...>Astonishing! The book you retrieved belongs to no one other than Gunther Arcanus!Gunther was a skilled Necromancer in life; he and I were friends and comrades-in-arms, before the Plague. And judging from his book he has grown even more powerful in death.His skills would be a great boon to us.

data.objectivesText: Kill Rot Hide Graverobbers and Rot Hide Mongrels.
description: The Mass Graves, southwest of Garren's Haunt to the north, were made to accommodate the...impressive...number of deaths Tirisfal suffered when the Plague first came.
The bodies in these graves have so far been spared an undeath, but the Scourge now send Rot Hide Gnolls to gather the corpses and use them to bolster their armies.  This cannot be allowed!
Your task is twofold: slay the Rot Hides at the Mass Grave and Garren's Haunt, and gather from them the Embalming Ichor that gives them life.
data.partialDialogue: Is your task complete?  Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?
data.turnInDialogue: Expertly done, ‹name›. The Scourge are mistaken if they think they can use those corpses against us, and the fluid you gathered from the Rot Hide slaves will be studied by our Apothecaries. It may have secrets we can use against them.As I said, well done. But our struggle continues, and the conflict will surely offer you more chances to prove your worth to the Forsaken.

data.objectivesText: Return Gunther's Spellbook to him, on the island of Gunther's Retreat.
description: Long ago Gunther and I, along with the now Scourge Necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, were friends and students within the Kirin Tor - a society of mages in Dalaran.
Gunther and I both fell to the Plague, but I thought he either remained dead, or was raised into the ranks of the Lich King.  It is good to know he is free.
We must have him.  I have placed a spell on his book that, when he sees it, will show him that I too am free of the Lich King.  After knowing this, it is my hope that he will join us.
data.partialDialogue: Your masters are fools to send you here, for I will never again be a Scourge slave!
data.turnInDialogue: My book?!? So you were the thief who stole it!But...what is this new enchantment upon it...Bethor? He is in Lordaeron?If he still exists, then perhaps he too escaped from the Lich King's grasp...

data.objectivesText: Deliver the Scarlet Crusade Documents to Executor Zygand in Brill.
description: These will need to be taken to my superior, Executor Zygand, in Brill. With this information, we'll be able to deal a decisive blow to the Scarlet Crusade. Your services have been useful here in Deathknell, but I need someone to deliver this to Zygand, and I believe he'll be able to find you more appropriate work.
Take the road north out of Deathknell. Soon after entering Tirisfal proper, you'll hit a crossroads. Take the eastern fork, and keep going east. You'll pass Cold Hearth Manor along the way.
data.partialDialogue: Yes, what do you want?

data.objectivesText: Present Sevren's Orders to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
description: Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful mage in the Undercity to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge.  You, ‹name›, will be that agent.
Present these orders to Bethor.  He will then instruct you on your mission.  I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich.  And it will be dangerous.
So ready yourself, ‹class›.  You must not fail.
You may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
data.partialDialogue: Greetings. Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...
data.turnInDialogue: Ah, you are the agent sent by Magistrate Sevren. Then yes, your business with me is crucial.I trust Sevren has mustered someone suitable for my task...but we shall see.

data.objectivesText: Obtain a Candle of Beckoning.
description: You say you are not bound by the will of the Lich King, and the enchantment Bethor placed upon my book corroborates this.  But before I believe you I must have proof that you are enemy to the Scourge.
There is an old, bloody altar just off the southern coast of this island.  it is used by a powerful Scourge agent, Lillith Nefara.
Take a Candle of Beckoning from this crate here.  Light it on the altar and Lillith will awake.  Destroy Lillith, and I will believe you are the Lich King's foe.
data.partialDialogue: I await proof of your allegiance, ‹class›.
data.turnInDialogue: You have defeated Lillith Nefara, proving you are an enemy of the Scourge. Incredible.I had believed I was the only Undead with free will, but you have shown me there are others who have broken the Lich King's domination.

data.objectivesText: Take the Barrel of Shimmer Stout to Mountaineer Barleybrew.

He may not be a brewer like the rest of us Barleybrews, but he loves his drinks and I know he'll like this one.

data.turnInDialogue: <Mountaineer Barleybrew tastes the Shimmer Stout...>Oh. Whoa! This stuff really puts a shine in your eyes. I feel like I can see in the dark!

data.objectivesText: Gather 3 discolored worg hearts and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
description: My brother Quinn was badly hurt by the ghoul, Ivar the Foul, and I don't know if he will heal properly without alchemical aid.  Although I am not an apothecary, I do know that our apothecaries can make healing potions from the discolored hearts of worgs.
Gather such hearts and take them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher to the south.  Then return here with the potion.
You can find plenty of worgs between here and Malden's Orchard to the east.
data.partialDialogue: My time is short, ‹class›, for the Dark Lady has charged me with a grave task.

data.objectivesText: Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields.
description: Our initial scouting reports of Silverpine show the rot hides have a base at an old farm to the north, the Dead Fields.  We have sent small assaults against them, but each time they are reinforced by the banshee Nightlash, who uses her magic to rout our forces.
We want Nightlash destroyed.
Go to the Dead Fields and assault the rot hides.  If you don't see Nightlash then kill the rot hides until she appears, then defeat her.
Her essence will turn to dust.  Bring me that dust as proof.
data.partialDialogue: Have you defeated Nightlash, ‹name›?  Our success against the rot hides depends on her destruction!
data.turnInDialogue: I heard of your successful raid against the rot hides, ‹name›, and this essence is proof of Nightlash's death.The Scourge have lost ground this day. Your value to the Forsaken grows.

data.objectivesText: Kill 7 Young Nightsabers and 4 Young Thistle Boars and return to Conservator Ilthalaine.
description: Greetings, ‹name›.  I am Conservator Ilthalaine.  My purpose in Shadowglen is to ensure that the balance of nature is maintained.
The spring rains were particularly heavy this year, causing some of the forest's beasts to flourish while others suffered.

Unfortunately, the nightsaber and thistle boar populations grew too large.  Shadowglen can only produce so much food for the beasts.  Journey forth, young ‹class›, and thin the boar and saber populations so that nature's harmony will be preserved.
data.partialDialogue: There is still work to be done, ‹name›. Return to me once you have thinned the nightsaber and thistle boar populations.

data.objectivesText: Kill 6 Hillsbrad Farmhands, 6 Hillsbrad Farmers, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
description: Stand at attention while addressing me, ‹class›.
I am under direct command of Varimathras.  We are to quell the human infestation until our apothecaries can develop the new plague.
Our information leads us to believe that the town of Hillsbrad is vulnerable to attack.  Your first assignment is aimed at disrupting their food supply and infrastructure.
Travel west.  Raid the northernmost farms of Hillsbrad Fields.  Make sure that the landowners, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz, are executed as well.
data.partialDialogue: As High Executor of Tarren Mill, under the direct command of Varimathras and the Dark Lady, you are subject to follow my command.Perhaps you take this war with the Alliance lightly? If such is the case I should behead you right here and now. Otherwise, travel west to the town of Hillsbrad and wage battle against the humans, as ordered.Dismissed.
data.turnInDialogue: At ease, ‹class›. I see you have returned from battle. My sources tell me you performed well on the Hillsbrad front.

data.objectivesText: Bring 9 Bloodscalp Tusks to Nimboya at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
description: A doom, there is.  A doom on my chief's youngest son, Yenniku.  As is a custom with our people, he was given to the Gurubashi Trolls of Zul'Gurub, but after my tribe, the Darkspear tribe, left with the orc Thrall, poor Yenniku was lost to us.  I was sent from distant Orgrimmar, back to Stranglethorn, to search for my chief's son.
And I believe the Bloodscalp tribe has him.
If you would help me, then hunt the Bloodscalps.  You may find them to the north.  Gather their tusks and return to me.
data.partialDialogue: ‹class›. Show me you have made prey of the Bloodscalp tribe.Show me your trophies.
data.turnInDialogue: These are good tusks, ‹name›. You prove that you have the strength to hunt the Bloodscalps.And that is good, because you are not done hunting them.

data.objectivesText: Bring 20 Shrunken Heads to Nimboya at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
description: We must find if Yenniku is dead.
Slay the Bloodscalp Headhunters and take from them their Shrunken Heads.  You must gather many, many heads, and I will inspect them to make sure Yenniku's head is not among them.
And if Yenniku was killed by the Bloodscalps, then may a 600-year curse fall on the spirit of their chief, Gan'zulah!
Go, ‹name›.  You may find many Headhunters at the ruins of Zuuldaia and Zul'Kunda, along the coast to the north.
data.partialDialogue: ‹name›. I fear for our chief's son. Do you have the shrunken heads so I may inspect them?
