data.objectivesText: Collect 25 Ogre Warbeads from Ogres inside Dire Maul or Blackrock Spire and return to Falrin Treeshaper inside the Athenaeum in Dire Maul.
description: Yes, it is true that I am familiar with this enchantment you require, ‹class›.  Yet I'm not one to give out favors freely, even if you were sent here by an old friend.
I hold nothing but hatred and contempt for our brutish ogre neighbors.  And not only them, I hate the followers of Omokk just as much as I hate those that follow King Gordok.
I want you to kill them.  Kill lots of them!  Bring me the beads they carry around their neck as proof of your work.  Do this and we shall talk about your request.
data.partialDialogue: Have you performed the favor I asked of you, ‹name›?
data.turnInDialogue: Hmmm... strangely enough I don't feel any better about my brother's death at the hands of those brutes.Well, you held your end of the bargain. Let's see what I can do for you.

data.objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Mountain and use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to find Bodley near Blackrock Spire.
description: So we need to recover the rest of the medallion?  Finding Bodley's going to be a bit of a headache.  He went back to Blackrock Mountain to attempt to re-enter Blackrock Spire and never came back.
I'd suggest taking the goblin's ghost revealing device with you, as I fear the worst might have happened.
data.turnInDialogue: I am so glad that you can see me. Finally someone to talk to!Will you help us, ‹name›? Help to undo the wrong that we perpetrated and put things to right? If it's true that you already have the Top Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet, then I think I can point you in the right direction to acquire the other two parts, reunite them and put an end to all of this.Oh, by the way, hello, my name is Bodley. Nice to meet you!

data.objectivesText: Gather the Incendicite of Incendius, the Ember of Emberseer and the Cinder of Cynders, along with a Hallowed Brazier, and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
description: In order to summon Lord Valthalak we're first going to need to gather the other two-thirds of the amulet. To do that we need to get a brazier and some special coals to burn in it.

There are three nobles of fire, Lord Incedius in Blackrock Depths, Pyroguard Emberseer in Blackrock Spire and The Duke of Cynders in Silithus, with what we need. Collect from each a piece of their remains, and then return to me with a Hallowed Brazier, which can be purchased from the Argent Dawn if you are honored by them.
data.partialDialogue: It was our folly... our doom that we took that last job. If only we hadn't inadvertently stolen Lord Valthalak's spirit, which was contained in the amulet; if only there weren't those in our mercenary group that had been so greedy and divided it up amongst themselves. I'd be alive today, maybe tossing back a beer, or tossing one of my kids into the air.‹name›, don't let the avarice of the ignoble in our old mercenary company be your doom as well.
data.turnInDialogue: I'm impressed, ‹class›, but there's no time to lose. I will give you your next task, because you will still need to acquire a few more important components before we can proceed.Speak to me again when you feel that you are ready for the challenge that lies ahead.

data.objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.

objectiveItems.name: Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

description: My friend, Mor Grayhoof, was the first to fall victim to possession of a piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, and the corrupting spirit fragment that it contains. After stealing Valthalak's spellbook and amulet, we fled for our lives from the upper portion of Blackrock Spire. Along the way, Mor fell into the lower portion of the spire.
Later, we discovered that he survived the fall, only to be captured and tortured by War Master Voone. A few spectral assassins snuck in and slew him right in front of Voone.
data.partialDialogue: Then it is done? You have retrieved the left piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet and finally put to rest the spirit of my old companion, Mor Grayhoof?
data.turnInDialogue: You have done a great thing, ‹name›. One spirit rests in peace, but there is still much work to be done before we can put all of this behind us.Unfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.

description: It became known to us in later days, as we were doing what we could ourselves to survive, that Isalien, a night elf priestess of our company, had gone to the night elvic ancestral city, now known as Dire Maul. From what we gathered, she went there both for personal reasons and also to unlock the secrets of the piece of the amulet that she had in her possession.
She didn't quite make it, though. Word got back to us that she was ambushed at the Shrine of Eldretharr by Alzzin the Wildshaper and his forces.
data.partialDialogue: Surely you haven't already dealt with the salvation of Isalien's spirit and the retrieval of the left piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, ‹name›?
data.turnInDialogue: Thank you, ‹name›, for putting Isalien's spirit to rest. Now, perhaps, she will find peace with her goddess. But, there is still a great deal of work ahead of us if we are to get out of this fine pickle we find ourselves in.Unfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.

description: The siblings, Jarien and Sothos, decided to join the Scarlet Crusade upon the disbanding of our mercenary company. They took the left piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet with them. Good riddance, I say, but we need that piece back.
From what we could gather, they were actually slain by Grand Crusader Dathrohan himself for failing the initiation rites inside his chamber in the Scarlet Bastion.
In any case, we... meaning you, are still going to need to retrieve that piece of the amulet.
data.partialDialogue: Does this mean then, ‹class›, that you've already put the souls of those two fools to rest and retrieved the left piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet?
data.turnInDialogue: I suppose it's for the best that the souls of those two have finally been put to rest, even if I didn't like them while they were alive. In any case, we have what we were after, and that is definitely a good thing!Unfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. description: Now we have what we need, so it's time to discuss who it is that you'll be summoning.

Kormok was ok for an ogre, right up until he turned to necromancy. After that, things got creepy for just about everyone in the outfit. It was no surprise then when he took his piece of the amulet and returned to his new home, Scholomance.
But even there, or perhaps especially there, he was not safe from the spectral assassins. They slew him right in front of his master, Ras Frostwhisper.
data.partialDialogue: I commend you, ‹name›, if you have returned with the left piece of the amulet. If not, however, please take care of that as there is no time to waste, I assure you!
data.turnInDialogue: Good work, ‹name›! Kormok wasn't all that bad for an ogre, at least not while he was still alive, so I hope he gets the rest that he deserves. But, there is more work ahead of us.Unfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.

providedItems.name: Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

description: As I was saying, ‹class›, in my living years I flirted with becoming a diviner. But, there really wasn't as much profit in it as you might imagine, mostly because it's dangerous and the reagents are rare and expensive. However, I do know enough to be able to pinpoint the final piece of the amulet, and the spirit of my former comrade along with it.
This is where you come in, ‹name›. I need you to go to Alcaz Island off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh and collect Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga that live there.
data.partialDialogue: Bloodkelp, ‹name›, a big stack of it, that's what I need to power my divinatory spells. You're likely to need to take at least a couple of friends along with you to Alcaz Island to gather it up... those Strashaz are a nasty lot!
data.turnInDialogue: To be honest, ‹name›, I'm surprised you made it back in one piece. Then again, I guess Alcaz Island is the least of your worries right now.Ok, give me a moment here... divination isn't something that you can just snap your fingers and expect accurate answers from.

data.objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
description: My friend, Mor Grayhoof, was the first to fall victim to possession of a piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, and the corrupting spirit fragment that it contains. After stealing Valthalak's spellbook and amulet, we fled for our lives from the upper portion of Blackrock Spire. Along the way, Mor fell into the lower portion of the spire.
Later, we discovered that he survived the fall, only to be captured and tortured by War Master Voone. A few spectral assassins snuck in and slew him right in front of Voone.
data.partialDialogue: Then it is done? You have retrieved the right piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, recombined the amulet into one whole, and finally put to rest the spirit of my old companion, Mor Grayhoof?
data.turnInDialogue: Thank you for helping Mor Grayhoof, ‹name›. Another spirit rests in peace, and we now have the reassembled amulet! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.In order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.

data.objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
description: It became known to us in later days, as we were doing what we could ourselves to survive, that Isalien, a night elf priestess of our company, had gone to the night elvic ancestral city, now known as Dire Maul. From what we gathered, she went there both for personal reasons and also to unlock the secrets of the piece of the amulet that she had in her possession.
She didn't quite make it, though. Word got back to us that she was ambushed at the Shrine of Eldretharr by Alzzin the Wildshaper and his forces.
data.partialDialogue: Surely you haven't already dealt with the salvation of Isalien's spirit and the retrieval of the right piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, ‹name›? Be sure to recombine the pieces of the amulet before handing it to me.
data.turnInDialogue: Thank you, ‹name›, for putting Isalien's spirit to rest. Now, perhaps, she will find peace with her goddess. And, we have the reassembled amulet, as well! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.In order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.

data.objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Jarien and Sothos and slay them. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
description: The siblings, Jarien and Sothos, decided to join the Scarlet Crusade upon the disbanding of our mercenary company. They took the right piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet with them. Good riddance, I say, but we need that piece back.
From what we could gather, they were actually slain by Grand Crusader Dathrohan himself for failing the initiation rites inside his chamber in the Scarlet Bastion.
In any case, we... meaning you, are still going to need to retrieve that piece of the amulet.
data.partialDialogue: Does this mean then, ‹class›, that you've already put the souls of those two fools to rest and recombined the pieces of Lord Valthalak's amulet?
data.turnInDialogue: I suppose it's for the best that the souls of those two have finally been put to rest, even if I didn't like them while they were alive. In any case, we have what we were after, and now the amulet is reassembled! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.In order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.

data.objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Kormok and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
description: Now we have what we need, so it's time to discuss who it is that you'll be summoning next.

Kormok was ok for an ogre, right up until he turned to necromancy. After that, things got creepy for just about everyone in the outfit. It was no surprise then when he took his piece of the amulet and returned to his new home, Scholomance.
But even there, or perhaps especially there, he was not safe from the spectral assassins. They slew him right in front of his master, Ras Frostwhisper.
data.partialDialogue: I commend you, ‹name›, if you have returned with the completed amulet. If not, however, please take care of that as there is no time to waste, I assure you!
data.turnInDialogue: Good work, ‹name›! Kormok wasn't all that bad for an ogre, at least not while he was still alive, so I hope he gets the rest that he deserves. And now we have the completed amulet! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.In order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.

data.objectivesText: Gather 40 Blackrock Bracers and acquire a Flask of Supreme Power. Return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
description: We're nearly there, ‹class›. All that is left is to retrieve a few more components so that I can attune the brazier and enable it to beckon forth Lord Valthalak.

To begin I must ask you to journey forth into Blackrock Spire and slay the orcs therein. They wear bracers that contain trace metals that I will need, so I'll need more than a few to extract the right amount out of them. Then, to complete the imbuing process, you'll need to bring me a Flask of Supreme Power.
Good luck, ‹name›!
data.partialDialogue: We've come a long way, ‹name›, and I just wanted to say that no matter what happens, thank you! You've put yourself in mortal danger to try to help the surviving members of our mercenary company, The Veiled Blade, and as far as I'm concerned, you're one of us now.
data.turnInDialogue: That's it then. I'll extract the metal from the bracers and imbue the brazier with these final components. Then it will be ready for you to summon Lord Valthalak, and finally return his spirit amulet to him.You've come quite a distance, ‹name›, don't falter now that the end is in sight!

data.objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon Lord Valthalak. Dispatch him, and use Lord Valthalak's Amulet on the corpse. Then, return Lord Valthalak's Amulet to the Spirit of Lord Valthalak.
description: All is now ready, ‹name›.

When alive, Lord Valthalak used to inhabit what is now The Beast's chamber. Go there and use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Lord Valthalak. It will reincorporate him, so he'll have to be killed again. I'd take care of The Beast first, and be sure take enough friends along to survive the upper portion of Blackrock Spire.
Once you've dispatched Valthalak, use the amulet on his corpse. With his spirit reunified, he'll likely want his amulet back, as well.
Good luck!
data.partialDialogue: ‹class›, you dare disturb my rest!
data.turnInDialogue: How fortunate for you that I know you're not part of the original group that stole this from me.I'll take back what is mine now, mortal! Give the amulet to me!

data.objectivesText: Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain and give him the Brazier of Beckoning.
description: I will ignore your impertinence this time, ‹class›, because you have done a noble thing today; returning the rest of my stolen spirit to me. Despite your obviously weak nature, ‹race›, you have shown courage where those that stole from me did not, and probably never could!
Return to them, before I change my mind and slay you where you stand. Go back and tell them that they are safe... for now.
data.partialDialogue: ‹name›, you're back and still alive! Well, at least that makes one of us.You're going to have to tell me all about it!
data.turnInDialogue: He really said all of that? Wow, I can't believe he's going to call off the spectral assassins and stalkers, even if he did hint at causing my living companions further harm in the future.This is a great day, ‹name›! You've accomplished what few ever could, and absolved us, at least in part, of some of our past sins.Thank you! As a sign of appreciation, I'd like to give you this. You can use it to summon forth spirits at the same haunted locations that you already have, and a few others, too.

description: Heed me well, ‹name›.  For the banner to work in the desired way, you will need to step into the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths.  Allow yourself to be sentenced by High Justice Grimstone and place the banner firmly on the ground in a sign of defiance.

data.objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Mountain and use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to find Bodley near Blackrock Spire.
description: The medallion contained Valthalak's soul?  It's no surprise it was guarded by such a powerful curse.
Locating Bodley presents a bit of a problem.  Last time I heard of him, he was preparing to venture back into Blackrock Spire.  He was never heard of again.
Seek him out in Blackrock Mountain, though I'm afraid to say he's probably dead by now.  I suggest taking the goblin's device with you, friend.
data.turnInDialogue: I am so glad that you can see me. Finally someone to talk to!Will you help us, ‹name›? Help to undo the wrong that we perpetrated and put things to right? If it's true that you already have the Top Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet, then I think I can point you in the right direction to acquire the other two parts, reunite them and put an end to all of this.Oh, by the way, hello, my name is Bodley. data.objectivesText: Speak with Marshal McBride.
description: I hope you strapped your belt on tight, young ‹class›, because there is work to do here in Northshire.
And I don't mean farming.

The Stormwind guards are hard pressed to keep the peace here, with so many of us in distant lands and so many threats pressing close.  And so we're enlisting the aid of anyone willing to defend their home.  And their alliance.
If you're here to answer the call, then speak with my superior, Marshal McBride.  He's inside the abbey behind me.
data.turnInDialogue: Ah, good.  Another volunteer.  We're getting a lot of you these days.I hope it's enough.The human lands are threatened from without, and so many of our forces have been marshaled abroad.  This, in turn, leaves room for corrupt and lawless groups to thrive within our borders.It is a many-fronted battle we wage, ‹name›.  Gird yourself for a long campaign.

The quilboar aren't the first tae weaponize the elements irresponsibly, and they won't be the last. If we want to prepare our own counter-ritual, we'll need a better understanding of these twisted elements. Take this book. It details the many denizens of Azeroth and how they practice shamanism.
If you can learn from them, maybe we can find a solution.

data.objectivesText: Search for Corma's partner Essene.
description: Thandol Span has been a dangerous place since the Dark Irons blew up the bridge, but I didn't expect to run into them there!

data.objectivesText: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
description: I bring ill tidings from Dalaran. Something has disrupted our ley lines, causing erratic and destructive behavior from our constructs in the city.

We know not yet what is causing this mayhem. The high council has ordered us to keep this matter private so as to not bring shame to our order. But we cannot keep up this charade forever. The city is being overrun as we speak!
Archmage Modera has dispatched me to solicit outside aid. Seek her image out near Dalaran beside Lordamere Lake.

description: We already know these crystals are capable of more than sundering the ground--the Gelkis have proven that they can be twisted for necromantic power. data.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and use the Enhanced Necromancy Staff to fully raise undead that are struggling to emerge throughout the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul once the Magram army has grown.
description: I can see the excitement in your eyes, outsider. Do you grasp the potential of necromancy yet?
Of course you do. And that is why I am ordering you to hone your skills further.

As you venture deeper into the Valley of Bones, you will see the remains of failed attempts at raising the dead. Gelkis attempts, no doubt. Hardly able to claw out from the dirt. Funny, were it not so pathetic.
I have imbued your staff with greater power. Use this to grow our army, and crush the ones that fight back!

data.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and dispel the necromantic curse present on the Accursed Skull. Once successful, report back to Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones.
description: I have placed the skull you provided alongside several bones I found while awaiting your return. Immediately I saw a sickly light spread from the skull and claim those old bones as its own. I see now why the call of necromancy is so hard to resist.
Do you remember this crystal? It is draenethyst. I know little of its potential, but I believe it can channel Theradras' power. With it, perhaps you can dispel the curse.
The ritual site can be found by the pond just east of the village.

description: There was a brief battle between a few of the necromancers just around the hill, and I used that to take a closer look inside.

‹name›, not all of our recent losses were defectors. There are Gelkis being held captive further in the valley! I was not able to investigate their situation because a hulking Magram brute started charging my direction. I consider myself fortunate he lost interest quickly.
You must go back into the Valley of Bones and free them. The Gelkis stand together.

description: About this staff of yours. I recognize it as one of Uthek's, and you mentioned it was constructed with Theradras' Tears, augmented with a Draenethyst Crystal, and that it can dispel dark magic?

I noticed that there are skeletons stuck just underneath the rocky soil further into the valley. I believe these are failed summons from the Outcast Necromancers, doomed perhaps forever to an existence smothered in dirt.
Laying them to rest again would be good for our cause, and their spirits.

description: On the other side of the valley, we have established a small foothold to prepare to march into the forest nearby. Before you head straight there, I want you to deal with a recent Bristleback intrusion along the way. They seem to have arrived right around the same time we did, but managed to secure an artifact from the nearby temple that has kept us at bay.
This task is simple. Look for the thorns and the pigs. Kill a bunch, indiscriminately. Then report to Hagiak at the camp I mentioned.

data.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and escort Rokren out of the Outcast Hideaway. Then inform Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones about what happened.
description: You! I saw you outside fighting the outcasts. I know not where you come from, but I need your help.

I was lured here by my Gelkis brethren with an assurance of safety. I knew the war in the Desolace was escalating beyond our control, but I never imagined my own people turning to necromancy in a convoluted bid to defect to the Magram clan. When I spoke out against this, they threatened to kill me if I ever stepped hoof outside this tent!
Please help.

description: As much as I would like Uthek or Khan Shaka to give the order, I fear our window of opportunity is short. Too short to consult those at Gelkis Village.
I believe with the situation unfolding here at the Valley of Bones that the Magram have left Khan Jehn with minimal defenses. If there was ever a time to attack another clan's Khan, it is now.
But ‹name›, a Khan is not to be trifled with, least of all Jehn. If you are brave enough to make your move, you must be swift but do not underestimate him.

data.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram and perform a necromancy ritual to resurrect Khan Jehn. The ritual site can be found in a tent at the central lake of Magram Village.
description: The leader of our clan, Khan Jehn, was slain by a band of outsiders much like you. They were acting on behalf of the Gelkis Clan.
You can stop feigning your surprise. An assault on Magram Village while our attention was elsewhere is a predictable war strategy, especially for the Gelkis.
Do you know why I am showing no rage or remorse, outsider?
<Orgrul hands you a familiar weapon, imbued with even greater power than the last time you held it.>
This is why.

data.objectivesText: Acquire 5 Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point.
description: It likely comes as no surprise to you that both of the centaur clans are hesitant to accept aid from anyone outside of their clan. This is especially true for folks like you and me - you know, non-centaurs.

One thing we all have in common is an understanding that money is power, and we have learned that the local centaur barter with carved wood. If you bring me a few samples of their designs, I can put in a rush order for similar etchings. Perhaps we can buy ourselves an advantage.

data.objectivesText: Acquire 5 Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.
description: I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.

I believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.

data.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.
description: Siding with the Magram would be my choice. There is no question that they are the dominant clan in the present day, regardless of their previous struggles. I have heard reports that they are brutally hostile against the Gelkis.

I sympathize with both warring clans and especially the Gelkis, but this is their war; not ours. We ought to side with the faction that poses the least risk to our cause. I believe that to be the Magram.
Bring this to their quartermaster in Magram Village to the southeast.

data.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.
description: At first glance, I would wager that the Gelkis are struggling. Their numbers are far fewer than the Magram, and I rarely hear of them stomping around from our scouts.
Nonetheless, they are one of the dominant clans in the Desolace and survive to this day. They must be doing something right.
If you want to make peace with the Gelkis, take this tote of totems with you to Gelkis Village far to the southwest. Primitive as they may be, they are likely to have a treasurer of some kind.

data.objectivesText: Slay 10 Lost Ones in the Fallow Sanctuary.
description: Although they are our kin, the Lost Ones of Fallow Sanctuary have become beings of pure violence and hatred.
There can be no redemption or salvation for them. They are doomed to wander this swamp as mindless, hateful creatures for all their lives.
Their suffering must end. Someone must put them out of their misery. A grisly task, I know, but would you do it to protect those of us who remain?

data.objectivesText: Find the Lost One Fisherman who stole Pelluk's lure, and take it back.
description: Now they've really done it! As if those wretches weren't already enough to deal with, one of them has stolen my lucky lure!

I was just out fishing this morning, when one came up out of the muck, cut my line, and ran off with it. The thief is almost certainly one of the Lost Ones' own fishermen, hoping to use the lure themselves.
Well, our supply of fish depends on that lure, so I need it back. The Lost Ones fish along the banks east of here. Find that thief, ‹race›!

data.objectivesText: Find the mage in Desolace who knows about the power of draenethyst.
description: Allow me to admit something, ‹name›. While draenethyst is sacred to us, and keeps us sane, none here fully understand it.
I recall a mage who once came to the Harborage, from Desolace. A human by the name of Azore. He feared the power of the draenethyst; said it shouldn't fall into the wrong hands.
At the time, we drove him away to protect what was ours. Lately, however, I find myself wondering what exactly he knew.
I ask that you find this mage, ‹race›. His knowledge could be of immense value to us.

description: I suppose it would be more accurate to say I know someone who knows a thing or two about draenethyst.

You see, the warlocks of the Burning Blade have been studying it. It is a substance from beyond the dark portal, so it follows that those involved with darker arts might wish to harness it to their own ends. We cannot allow this, obviously.
The specific warlock you seek is named Gimashi. She can be found atop her tower, which is in a ravine to the southeast. Her notes will have the answers you seek.

data.objectivesText: Escort Father Tuttle to The Harborage.
description: Oh thank goodness, someone civilized!

I came here on behalf of the Church of the Holy Light to make contact with the draenei of the Harborage. The Alliance has no foothold here, you see, and a bit of diplomacy with the locals may help us in that regard. The Light welcomes all into its fold, after all!
However, the road past this bridge is crawling with the draenei's more savage kin. If I am to make it to the Harborage safely, I will need protection. Would you aid me, ‹class›?

data.objectivesText: Find the missing courier, and ensure Dar's shipment is delivered to the Harborage.
description: The draenei of the Harborage are skilled fishermen, and willing to trawl more dangerous waters than I. We occasionally trade. They give us some of their catch, and I offer some of our extra supplies.
I'd sent a goblin courier to deliver my latest shipment, but he never returned. A crocolisk likely made a meal of him.
More importantly, my business reputation is at stake. That shipment must be found, and delivered to the harborage. Please, find it if you can. Check near the waters along the road.

description: The Alliance had an army of mages known as the Kirin Tor. While they were powerful, the demonic Burning Legion proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.
That is, until they rebuilt Dalaran. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!
While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.

The element o' air's a tricky one to master, but I've faith your skill will see ye through any challenge.
Make your way north into Arathi Highlands. In its northern hills, you'll find Veyric Thundervein. He'll teach ye more.

description: The fierce Magram are undoubtedly winning the war of territories at the moment. While we can all be thankful the clashes haven't erupted too frequently throughout the desert, every day their village just to the east grows a little bigger; their soldiers a little bolder.
I worry gravely about the consequences of an unchecked Magram clan, but I cannot deny their potential as an ally.
If you wish to earn their trust, offer this sack of totems to their quartermaster, but be careful.

I have trustworthy intel that suggests, between the Magram and the Gelkis, the latter are very much on the losing side. This may work to our advantage--desperation may push the isolated clan into opening up to outside help.
I have prepared a tote of totems for you to take to their quartermaster, assuming they have one, in Gelkis Village. This may work in our favor.

data.objectivesText: Kill a Highland Horror within Excavation Sites and bring its root core to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.
description: These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.
The creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.
Go to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's root core.

description: My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!
If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.

data.objectivesText: Slay the Dragonmaw forces within the Excavation Site and return to the Deathstalker Agent outside with anything you recover.
description: Dragonmaw. <She lets out a dry, amused scoff.>
The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?
Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.
If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.

data.objectivesText: Enter the Excavation Sites in the Wetlands and bring back Thicket Raptor Meat.
description:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.
Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.
A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.
Up for a job?

description: From time to time, I correspond with others in my craft--herbalists or eccentrics who study rare plants and local oddities. We trade discoveries, and sometimes warnings of what lies ahead.
One alchemist in the Wetlands wrote of an excavation team her husband was part of, uncovering signs of a long-lost primordial grass... but she never sent word of its abundance or accessibility.

description: This is odd. This piece of the tablet you have brought me refers to the lost city of I'lalai as if it is a massive sprawling civilization. But the ruins off of the reef are not large enough to be something of that size.

‹name›, to the north of the Vile Reef there is an ancient troll ruin on the hills along the coast. A tablet that contains legends of the lost troll city is within. I wish to study this legend further.
Take this hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of this tablet, then return to me.

data.objectivesText: Explore the Vile Reef and find the cavern entrance.
description: After rereading the legend, it doesn't seem like we are in the wrong place for the lost city, but perhaps there is yet some detail that has been overlooked.
In my younger years I used to dive in the Vile Reef ruins, but that was before the murlocs settled there. If memory serves there was a cavern there.
I have heard that there are now naga gathering in that region, which is unusual. I want to know what has lured them there.
Go and explore just west of the Vile Reef and return to me with any news.

data.objectivesText: Look for Dorin Songblade's brother, Daewyn, in Whelgar's Excavation Site.
description: Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.
Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.
Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.
If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?

description: ‹class›, your arrival is timely. I have just received new reports of naga activity just off of our coast. They seem to be swarming around some old troll ruins near the ocean floor.
We are already stretched thin defending from the local Bloodscalp and ogres ransacking our caravans. We cannot afford a surprise attack from the sea.
Go and slay as many as you are able, and bring me their tridents as proof of your success.

data.objectivesText: Return to Dorin Songblade.
description: <You cover the dwarf's body with his cloak.>
Travel to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.
data.turnInDialogue:
Ah no...
<He buries his head in his hands and sobs.>I should 'ave gone with 'em.Much of what I was smithin' was for 'im, was plannin' a surprise but it wasn't ready when he came by gettin' things for his journey.Now that these are finished, I don't have it in me to reforge or sell any of it.
You can have this. It's the least I can do for you, bringing me this grim day.

data.objectivesText: Return to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
description: I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.
<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>
Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.
Thank you.
data.partialDialogue: I'm more than worried about him!
data.turnInDialogue: Goodness, that sounds terrible!By the light, I'm grateful he's one of the survivors.<She holds the reed-woven heart to her own.>I'll start cooking a hearty meal for him. Thank you for bringing me this. I'd like you to have something as a token of our appreciation.

description: While war rages throughout the region, the Maraudine centaur stand unchallenged in the Valley of Spears. I worry that they will grow callous in time and stir further unrest if the other clans continue to turn a blind eye to their presence.
Khan Hratha possesses a Maraudine Key Fragment, and I wish to have it as a negotiation tactic. Find a war horn mouthpiece from the centaur there and use it to challenge him atop the highest peak.
Bring the key to me, and I will have a proposition for you.

description: There is an ancient tauren burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most tauren consider to be sacred.
It would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.

description: Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.

One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.
Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.

data.objectivesText: Kill Broodmother Valraxx at Gloomrise.
description: As is often the case with infestations such as the one we are facing at Gloomrise, a single powerful matriarch often leads to the rapid spread of a hostile spider population.

If we wish to drive these beasts off for good, we'll need to seek out the progenitor and end her. When you go to Gloomrise, seek out the broodmother there and destroy her. I'd advise you to bring allies, and be ready for anything. These seem to be no ordinary spiders.

If ye want the elements' respect, ye gotta repay yer debts to 'em. They help you, you help them. And right now they need all the help they can get from those who would abuse their power.
Earth's rumblin', ‹name›. It speaks of the quilboar amassin' for some ritual of terrible power. We need tae go investigate their kraul and see what they're up to. Bring me back whatever ye find.

Our agents have identified a key target among the ranks of the Syndicate: a man by the name of Lord Tomas.

He plays an instrumental role in the functions of Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you wish to be of service to Ravenholdt, go to Durnholde and eliminate him. The quicker, and quieter, the better.

data.objectivesText: Steal Barton's Scouting Report by pickpocketing it from him. Then, bring the report to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.
description: We have noticed a Syndicate scouting party prowling around the ruins of Alterac, led by a man named Barton.
They're clearly searching for something, but I cannot know what without reading his scouting reports.

I ask that you pickpocket the report from him, rather than killing him outright. Barton's death will tip off the Syndicate that we're on to them, and they will certainly take counter-measures to cover their tracks.
If you hope to find him, he is most likely among the Syndicate at Strahnbrad.

description: You there, ‹class›. I have a matter I could use assistance with.

I just so happen to be writing a thesis on the ancient Wildhammer runemasters of Grim Batol, and there's a particular tome I need to complete my research. According to our ledgers, a mage by the name of Doan checked the book out of the old Dalaran library before the Third War and never returned it!
Arcanist Doan is now holed up in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. Retrieve this book for me and you'll be well rewarded.

description: You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity.

So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you.
Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.

data.objectivesText: Defeat a variety of Hatefury satyr at Sargeron in Desolace and then return to Aka'rai in Shadowprey Village.
description: Ever strike a deal with a satyr, mon?
I have. How could I resist? The promise of power, knowledge far exceeding what any ordinary tome could offer... all alongside an eager and charismatic minion. What more could I ask for?
Bah, of course they would never bend the knee to a mortal. I bargained when I had nothing, only to be cast aside with even less.
Now, I want revenge. Revenge against the Hatefury. Raid their camp to the northeast! Stain the dirt with their foul blood.

description: If Malem is still alive, then I suspect the Burning Blade orcs are expecting someone to come searching for her soon enough. They will certainly be ready for a fight.
I would prefer if you kept a low profile and stayed out of their way, but the far more likely reality is that they will be looking to meet you, blade to Burning Blade, at every opportunity.
So how about we plan to keep score from the start. Kill as many as you can, and I'll make it worth your time.

description: You have done well to infiltrate the city of mages, but I believe it is time for us to be more... negotiatory.

My brilliant work still pales in comparison to the ancient wisdom the Kirin Tor have amassed over the years. I think it's high time we are granted access to this exclusive order, don't you think?
Take the mote you acquired. They will surely give anything to get it back. Anything.

description: You! Yes, you! Come here, keep your voice down!

I screwed up big time. I managed to secure a sweet deal for Booty Bay to use their zeppelin tower for expedited deliveries and on our very first route I saw a huge bird--err, got SHOT DOWN just to the east of here!
I survived the crash, unfortunately, but before I woke up, I was already being dragged by my ears! Now I'm surrounded by bloodthirsty trolls and locked in a cage!
Look, I just need the key, okay? I can escape on my own.

I fear if something isn't done soon, there will be no caravans that will dare make the trek to Freewind Post.

description: Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars.
Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.

That keep is the closest thing to home around here!

Take it with you and see if you can find a big Titan construct of some sort in the excavation. Read this here final passage on the stone and see what happens!

data.objectivesText: Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep wants you to destroy the 4 sets of Attack Plans in the Angerfang Encampment.
description: In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded!
They were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil.

Dun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next!

data.objectivesText: Bring the Tattered Spellbook to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor.
description: This book has been badly burned--perhaps by the dragonfire that destroyed much of the Dragonmaw clan.
Of what little is legible, it seems to describe rituals relating to the use of the Demon Soul that the clan had used to control the dragons.
It is far too incomplete to be of real use, but based on roughly inserted pages on animal hide it seems Nek'rosh had attempted to salvage it. Freshly dried ink mentions a "Shadow Council."
Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor would want to know about this.

data.objectivesText: Find Howin Kindfeather east of Menethil Harbor, along the road.
description: After the War of the Three Hammers that tore dwarven life as we knew it apart, the Wildhammers settled here, founding the mountain fortress of Grim Batol.
It was a wondrous place. Gryphons soared everywhere you looked, diving down through the wetlands to grab a fish.
It didn't last long, sadly.
Howin Kindfeather is one of the first Wildhammers to return in ages. Keeps to himself, far outside of town. Follow the road east--you'll find him eventually. He could surely use a hand.

description: The natural order of this land is breaking. Once it was that the Razormaw raptors kept the land from overgrowth. They now live in fear of their alpha, named only for the carnage it leaves behind.
I fear the beast has been driven mad by the sickness that we have yet to fully excise.
It will respond to the malignant flesh of the diseased bears below Raptor Ridge, to the northeast. Leave their entrails in its cave lair.
Carnage will come. Bring me its head.

data.objectivesText: Kill 8 Dragonmaw Reclaimers, 5 Dragonmaw Soulbinders, and 3 Dragonmaw Infiltrators in Dragonmaw Retreat for Howin Kindfeather.
description: I plan tae get back into Grim Batol and reclaim it for the Wildhammers, ‹name›. Or at least learn a thing or two.
Don't look at me like that, now. I know the risks. I don't intend tae go in hammer swingin', ye know.
Regardless, I'll need your help first. The Dragonmaw orcs march as we speak. They're all up an' down the Dragonmaw Retreat, where the red dragons routed them before.
I need you tae thin their numbers before I have any chance of gettin' close. Ye can't miss 'em if you follow the road east.

data.objectivesText: Kill the Subdued Dragonspawn at the Dragonmaw Gates for Howin Kindfeather.
description: I did a quick test flight while ye were out. The good news is the armor ye helped me craft for Bassbeak works like a charm!
The very bad news is I saw a group o' them Dragonmaw in the process of enslavin' a red dragonspawn.
Absolutely not. Not again.
You have tae take it out. You'll certainly need friends tae do so. Kill the warlocks holding it down first--that ought tae free it. Then put it out of its misery.
None of them will stand in the way of the Wildhammer.

data.objectivesText: Deliver Howin's Missive to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
description: My work here is far from over, ‹name›. And I need tae send word to me wife Claira in Aerie Peak--and get Falstad an update as well.
But that's my business. Wildhammer business.

That said, you ought tae let King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge know about all this as well. Wetlands is but a stone's throw from his lands, and none of what's happenin' here is good news on one's doorstep. This letter oughta do the trick.
Ye can travel back through Dun Algaz or fly from Menethil Harbor to get to Ironforge.

I'd be willing to bet if we can bring pieces of them as well, we'll reveal more of the Goaz Stone!

You'll find Ados at the Dragonmaw Gates to the east, near Grim Batol. Modr is right outside Dun Modr to the north. Golm lies beneath Grim Batol, east of Dun Algaz. Neru's behind Direforge Hill, to the northeast.

data.objectivesText: Maseara Autumnmoon wants you to search west of Forest Song, amongst the Satyrnaar demons. Report any signs of her husband Kurothel upon your return.
description: At the moment our fates bound us most vulnerable, tragedy fell upon our villages. Satyrs defiled our temples, their profane touch staining sacred boughs, and they slaughtered the innocent without mercy.
Kurothel was consumed by wrath. The druids are taking the fight to the satyr, and he has followed.
Our bond endures. I feel my husband, west, within these woods. Please, return to me with news of his fate.

Don't give me that look. I know it's run by goblins. Bartenders talk, and bar patrons talk a LOT. All I'm saying is that if you want to see things get real wild, head over there.

I'd like to think that you'll be noted in the history for it in the catalogue -- "Recovered by ‹name›! Authenticated by Prospector Whelgar..." Ah, I'm gettin' meself carried away.
High Explorer Magellas will receive you, and given the exquisite nature of what you carry, will surely be most generously appreciative should you donate it to the museum.
Good find!

data.objectivesText: Ahab Wheathoof at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore wants you to feed his prized puppy, Kyle the Frenzied.
description: Help, ‹name›! My prized puppy, Kyle, has run away! I just know he's running around Bloodhoof Village, lost and hungry.
Will you find him and feed him? Once he eats he will settle down and come home.

To feed him you will need to find food. His favorite meal is tender strider meat. Just venture east and you should find plenty of striders. Hunt one down and take its succulent meat to Kyle. When you see Kyle in town, put the meat down and he is sure to come to you.
